  onOpenBuyCredits?: () => void;
  onCloseBuyCredits?: () => void;
}

export const SettingsModal: React.FC<SettingsModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  selectedModel,
  setSelectedModel,
  outputLanguage,
  setOutputLanguage,
  isBuyCreditsDialogOpen,
  onOpenBuyCredits,
  onCloseBuyCredits,
}) => {
  const activeTab = useUiStore(state => state.settingsTab);
  const setActiveTab = useUiStore(state => state.setSettingsTab);
  const aiAccess = useUiStore(state => state.aiAccess);
  const accessMode = useUiStore(state => state.accessMode);
  const applicationLanguage = useUiStore(state => state.applicationLanguage);
  const setApplicationLanguage = useUiStore(state => state.setApplicationLanguage);
  const modelCapabilityCheck = useUiStore(state => state.modelCapabilityCheck);
  const setAiAccess = useUiStore(state => state.setAiAccess);
  const setModelCapabilityCheck = useUiStore(state => state.setModelCapabilityCheck);
  const [feedbackType, setFeedbackType] = useState<'suggestion' | 'bug' | null>(null);
  const [feedbackReason, setFeedbackReason] = useState('');
  const [feedbackImages, setFeedbackImages] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [contactAgreed, setContactAgreed] = useState(false);
  const [userEmail, setUserEmail] = useState('');
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [submitStatus, setSubmitStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'success' | 'error'>('idle');
  const [submitErrorMessage, setSubmitErrorMessage] = useState('Failed to submit feedback. Please try again later.');
  const [localBuyCreditsDialogOpen, setLocalBuyCreditsDialogOpen] = useState(false);

  const buyCreditsDialogOpen = isBuyCreditsDialogOpen ?? localBuyCreditsDialogOpen;
  const openBuyCreditsDialog = onOpenBuyCredits ?? (() => setLocalBuyCreditsDialogOpen(true));
  const closeBuyCreditsDialog = onCloseBuyCredits ?? (() => setLocalBuyCreditsDialogOpen(false));
  const text = getSettingsUIText(applicationLanguage as ApplicationLanguage);

  const selectedEndpointPreset =
    selectedModel.providerId === 'openai-compatible' ? selectedModel.endpointPreset || 'qwen' : undefined;

  const selectedModelValue =
    selectedModel.providerId === 'openai-compatible'
      ? `openai-compatible|${selectedEndpointPreset}|${selectedModel.modelId}`
      : `gemini|default|${selectedModel.modelId}`;

  const updateOpenAiAccess = (updater: (current: typeof aiAccess.openAiCompatible) => typeof aiAccess.openAiCompatible) => {
    setAiAccess({
      ...aiAccess,
      openAiCompatible: updater(aiAccess.openAiCompatible),
    });
  };

  const updateParserAccess = (updater: (current: typeof aiAccess.parser) => typeof aiAccess.parser) => {
    setAiAccess({
      ...aiAccess,
      parser: updater(aiAccess.parser),
    });
  };

  const handleModelSelectionChange = (rawValue: string) => {
    const [providerId, endpointPresetValue, modelId] = rawValue.split('|');

    if (providerId === 'openai-compatible') {
      const endpointPreset = endpointPresetValue as OpenAiCompatibleEndpointPreset;
      setSelectedModel({
        providerId: 'openai-compatible',
        endpointPreset,
        modelId,
      });

      updateOpenAiAccess((current) => ({
        ...current,
        endpointPreset,
        baseURL: endpointPreset === 'custom' ? current.baseURL : getOpenAiCompatibleBaseURL(endpointPreset),
      }));
      return;
    }

    setSelectedModel({
      providerId: providerId as ProviderId,
      modelId,
    });
  };

  const byokConfigReady =
    accessMode === 'byok' &&
    (selectedModel.providerId === 'gemini'
      ? aiAccess.gemini.apiKey.trim().length > 0
      : aiAccess.openAiCompatible.apiKey.trim().length > 0 &&
        aiAccess.openAiCompatible.baseURL.trim().length > 0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen || accessMode !== 'byok' || !byokConfigReady) {
      return;
    }

    let cancelled = false;
    const selection = {
      providerId: selectedModel.providerId,
      modelId: selectedModel.modelId,
      endpointPreset: selectedModel.providerId === 'openai-compatible' ? selectedEndpointPreset : undefined,
    };

    setModelCapabilityCheck({
      ...modelCapabilityCheck,
      status: 'checking',
      selection,
    });

    const timeoutId = window.setTimeout(() => {
      checkModelCapability({
        providerId: selectedModel.providerId,
        modelId: selectedModel.modelId,
        endpointPreset: selectedModel.providerId === 'openai-compatible' ? selectedEndpointPreset : undefined,
      })
        .then((result) => {
          if (cancelled) {
            return;
          }

          setModelCapabilityCheck({
            ...result,
            selection,
          });
        })
        .catch(() => {
          if (cancelled) {
            return;
          }

          setModelCapabilityCheck({
            status: 'pending',
            checkedAt: null,
            lastErrorCode: 'MODEL_CAPABILITY_CHECK_FAILED',
            capabilitySummary: null,
            selection,
          });
        });
    }, 150);

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    };
  }, [
    accessMode,
    aiAccess.gemini.apiKey,
    aiAccess.openAiCompatible.apiKey,
    aiAccess.openAiCompatible.baseURL,
    byokConfigReady,
    isOpen,
    selectedEndpointPreset,
    selectedModel.modelId,
    selectedModel.providerId,
  ]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleImageUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const files = e.target.files;
    if (!files) return;

    const newErrors = { ...errors };
    delete newErrors.images;

    if (feedbackImages.length + files.length > 3) {
      newErrors.images = 'You can only upload up to 3 images';
      setErrors(newErrors);
      return;
    }

    const newImages: string[] = [];
    let hasError = false;

    Array.from(files).forEach(file => {
      if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif'].includes(file.type)) {
        newErrors.images = 'Only JPG, PNG, and GIF formats are supported';
        hasError = true;
        return;
      }
      if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
        newErrors.images = 'Each image must be smaller than 5MB';
        hasError = true;
        return;
      }

      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = (e) => {
        if (e.target?.result) {
          setFeedbackImages(prev => [...prev, e.target!.result as string]);
        }
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    });

    if (hasError) {
      setErrors(newErrors);
    }
  };

  const removeImage = (index: number) => {
    setFeedbackImages(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  };

  const validateFeedback = () => {
    const newErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
    if (!feedbackType) newErrors.type = 'Please select a feedback type';
    if (!feedbackReason.trim()) newErrors.reason = 'Please describe your suggestion or the bug you encountered';
    if (contactAgreed) {
      if (!userEmail.trim()) {
        newErrors.email = 'Please enter your email address';
      } else if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(userEmail)) {
        newErrors.email = 'Please enter a valid email address';
      }
    }
    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  };

  const submitFeedback = async () => {
    if (!validateFeedback()) return;

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setSubmitStatus('idle');
    setSubmitErrorMessage('Failed to submit feedback. Please try again later.');

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/feedback', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          type: feedbackType === 'suggestion' ? 'Suggestion' : 'Bug',
          reason: feedbackReason,
          images: feedbackImages,
          contactAgreed,
          email: userEmail,
        }),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        const errorData = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(errorData.error || 'Submission failed');
      }

      setSubmitStatus('success');
      setTimeout(() => {
        onClose();
        // Reset form
        setFeedbackType(null);
        setFeedbackReason('');
        setFeedbackImages([]);
        setContactAgreed(false);
        setUserEmail('');
        setSubmitStatus('idle');
      }, 2000);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Feedback error:', error);
      setSubmitErrorMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to submit feedback. Please try again later.');
      setSubmitStatus('error');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4">
      <div className="bg-bg-elevated rounded-xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden border border-border-subtle">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 border-b border-border-subtle shrink-0">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-text-primary">{text.modalTitle}</h2>
          <button 
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-text-muted hover:text-text-secondary p-1 rounded-md hover:bg-bg-surface transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex flex-1 overflow-hidden">
          {/* Sidebar */}
          <div className="w-56 bg-bg-surface border-r border-border-subtle p-4 space-y-2 shrink-0 overflow-y-auto">
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('ai')}
              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${activeTab === 'ai' ? 'bg-bg-base text-text-primary' : 'text-text-secondary hover:bg-bg-base'}`}
            >
              <Cpu className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              {text.tabs.ai}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('appearance')}
              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${activeTab === 'appearance' ? 'bg-bg-base text-text-primary' : 'text-text-secondary hover:bg-bg-base'}`}
            >
              <Palette className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              {text.tabs.appearance}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('about')}
              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${activeTab === 'about' ? 'bg-bg-base text-text-primary' : 'text-text-secondary hover:bg-bg-base'}`}
            >
              <Info className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              {text.tabs.about}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('feedback')}
              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${activeTab === 'feedback' ? 'bg-bg-base text-text-primary' : 'text-text-secondary hover:bg-bg-base'}`}
            >
              <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              {text.tabs.feedback}
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Content */}
          <div className="flex-1 p-6 overflow-y-auto">
            {activeTab === 'ai' && (
              <div className="space-y-6">
                <h3 className="text-lg font-medium text-text-primary mb-4">{text.ai.sectionTitle}</h3>

                <PlatformApiSection onOpenBuyCredits={openBuyCreditsDialog} />

                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-text-secondary">
                    {text.ai.selectModel}
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={selectedModelValue}
                    onChange={(e) => handleModelSelectionChange(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-bg-surface border border-border-subtle text-text-primary rounded-lg focus:ring-stone-500 focus:border-stone-500 block p-2.5"
                  >
                    {MODEL_CONFIG.providers.map(provider => (
                      <optgroup key={provider.id} label={provider.name}>
                        {provider.models.map(model => (
                          <option
                            key={model.id}
                            value={`${provider.id}|${provider.id === 'openai-compatible' ? model.endpointPreset : 'default'}|${model.id}`}
                          >
                            {model.name}
                          </option>
                        ))}
                      </optgroup>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                {accessMode === 'byok' && (
                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-border-subtle bg-bg-surface p-4 space-y-4">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <h4 className="font-medium text-text-primary">{text.ai.myApiCredentials}</h4>
                      <InfoTrigger
                        placement="bottom"
                        content={text.ai.myApiCredentialsHelp}
                      />
                    </div>

                    {selectedModel.providerId === 'gemini' ? (
                      <div className="space-y-2">
                        <label htmlFor="gemini-api-key" className="block text-sm font-medium text-text-secondary">
                          Gemini API Key
                        </label>
                        <input
                          id="gemini-api-key"
                          type="password"
                          autoComplete="off"
                          value={aiAccess.gemini.apiKey}
                          onChange={(e) =>
                            setAiAccess({
                              ...aiAccess,
                              gemini: {
                                apiKey: e.target.value,
                              },
                            })
                          }
                          placeholder="AIza..."
                          className="w-full bg-bg-base border border-border-subtle text-text-primary rounded-lg p-2.5"
                        />
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="space-y-4">
                        <div className="space-y-2">
                          <label htmlFor="openai-endpoint-preset" className="block text-sm font-medium text-text-secondary">
                            Endpoint Preset
                          </label>
                          <select
                            id="openai-endpoint-preset"
                            value={selectedEndpointPreset}
                            onChange={(e) => {
                              const nextPreset = e.target.value as OpenAiCompatibleEndpointPreset;
                              const nextModelId = nextPreset === 'custom' ? 'custom-openai-model' : selectedModel.modelId;

                              setSelectedModel({
                                providerId: 'openai-compatible',
                                endpointPreset: nextPreset,
                                modelId: nextModelId,
                              });

                              updateOpenAiAccess((current) => ({
                                ...current,
                                endpointPreset: nextPreset,
                                baseURL: nextPreset === 'custom' ? current.baseURL : getOpenAiCompatibleBaseURL(nextPreset),
                              }));
                            }}
                            className="w-full bg-bg-base border border-border-subtle text-text-primary rounded-lg p-2.5"
                          >
                            <option value="qwen">Qwen (Aliyun)</option>
                            <option value="doubao">Doubao (Volcengine)</option>
                            <option value="custom">Custom OpenAI-Compatible</option>
                          </select>
                        </div>

                        <div className="space-y-2">
                          <label htmlFor="openai-api-key" className="block text-sm font-medium text-text-secondary">
                            OpenAI-Compatible API Key
                          </label>
                          <input
                            id="openai-api-key"
                            type="password"
                            autoComplete="off"
                            value={aiAccess.openAiCompatible.apiKey}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              updateOpenAiAccess((current) => ({
                                ...current,
                                apiKey: e.target.value,
                              }))
                            }
                            placeholder="sk-... or provider token"
                            className="w-full bg-bg-base border border-border-subtle text-text-primary rounded-lg p-2.5"
                          />
                        </div>

                        <div className="space-y-2">
                          <label htmlFor="openai-base-url" className="block text-sm font-medium text-text-secondary">
                            Base URL
                          </label>
                          <input
                            id="openai-base-url"
                            type="url"
                            autoComplete="off"
                            value={aiAccess.openAiCompatible.baseURL}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              updateOpenAiAccess((current) => ({
                                ...current,
                                baseURL: e.target.value,
                              }))
                            }
                            placeholder="https://your-provider.example/v1"
                            className="w-full bg-bg-base border border-border-subtle text-text-primary rounded-lg p-2.5"
                          />
                        </div>

                        {selectedEndpointPreset === 'custom' && (
                          <div className="space-y-2">
                            <label htmlFor="openai-model-id" className="block text-sm font-medium text-text-secondary">
                              Model ID
                            </label>
                            <input
                              id="openai-model-id"
                              type="text"
                              autoComplete="off"
                              value={selectedModel.modelId === 'custom-openai-model' ? '' : selectedModel.modelId}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                setSelectedModel({
                                  providerId: 'openai-compatible',
                                  endpointPreset: 'custom',
                                  modelId: e.target.value || 'custom-openai-model',
                                })
                              }
                              placeholder="gpt-4.1-mini or provider-specific model id"
                              className="w-full bg-bg-base border border-border-subtle text-text-primary rounded-lg p-2.5"
                            />
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}

                    <div className="space-y-4 rounded-lg border border-border-subtle bg-bg-base p-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <h5 className="font-medium text-text-primary">{text.ai.optionalParser}</h5>
                        <InfoTrigger
                          content={text.ai.optionalParserHelp}
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div className="space-y-2">
                        <label htmlFor="parser-provider" className="block text-sm font-medium text-text-secondary">
                          {text.ai.parserProvider}
                        </label>
                        <select
                          id="parser-provider"
                          value={aiAccess.parser.providerId}
                          onChange={(e) =>
                            updateParserAccess((current) => ({
                              ...current,
                              providerId: e.target.value === 'llamaparse' ? 'llamaparse' : 'none',
                              apiKey: e.target.value === 'llamaparse' ? current.apiKey : '',
                            }))
                          }
                          className="w-full bg-bg-surface border border-border-subtle text-text-primary rounded-lg p-2.5"
                        >
                          <option value="none">No Parser (Degraded)</option>
                          <option value="llamaparse">LlamaParse</option>
                        </select>
                      </div>

                      {aiAccess.parser.providerId === 'llamaparse' && (
                        <div className="space-y-2">
                          <label htmlFor="llamaparse-api-key" className="block text-sm font-medium text-text-secondary">
                            {text.ai.llamaParseApiKey}
                          </label>
                          <input
                            id="llamaparse-api-key"
                            type="password"
                            autoComplete="off"
                            value={aiAccess.parser.apiKey}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              updateParserAccess((current) => ({
                                ...current,
                                apiKey: e.target.value,
                              }))
                            }
                            placeholder="llx-..."
                            className="w-full bg-bg-surface border border-border-subtle text-text-primary rounded-lg p-2.5"
                          />
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {byokConfigReady && (
                      <div className="rounded-lg border border-border-subtle bg-bg-base p-4 text-sm">
                        {modelCapabilityCheck.status === 'checking' && (
                          <p className="text-text-secondary">Checking model compatibility...</p>
                        )}
                        {modelCapabilityCheck.status === 'usable' && (
                          <p className="text-text-primary">Model is ready</p>
                        )}
                        {modelCapabilityCheck.status === 'unusable' && (
                          <p className="text-red-600">This model cannot be used with SlideTutor right now.</p>
                        )}
                        {modelCapabilityCheck.status === 'pending' && (
                          <p className="text-text-muted">Compatibility check pending.</p>
                        )}
                        {modelCapabilityCheck.status === 'stale' && (
                          <p className="text-text-muted">Compatibility needs to be checked again.</p>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
                
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-text-secondary">
                    {text.ai.outputLanguage}
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={outputLanguage}
                    onChange={(e) => setOutputLanguage(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-bg-surface border border-border-subtle text-text-primary rounded-lg focus:ring-stone-500 focus:border-stone-500 block p-2.5"
                  >
                    <option value="English">English</option>
                    <option value="Chinese">涓枃 (Chinese)</option>
                    <option value="Spanish">Espa帽ol (Spanish)</option>
                    <option value="French">Fran莽ais (French)</option>
                    <option value="Japanese">鏃ユ湰瑾?(Japanese)</option>
                    <option value="Korean">頃滉淡鞏?(Korean)</option>
                  </select>
                  <p className="text-xs text-text-muted mt-1">
                    {text.ai.outputLanguageHelp}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {activeTab === 'appearance' && (
              <div className="space-y-6">
                <h3 className="text-lg font-medium text-text-primary mb-4">{text.appearance.sectionTitle}</h3>
                <div className="space-y-3 p-4 bg-bg-surface rounded-xl border border-border-subtle">
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-text-secondary">
                    {text.appearance.applicationLanguage}
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={applicationLanguage}
                    onChange={(e) => setApplicationLanguage(e.target.value as ApplicationLanguage)}
                    className="w-full bg-bg-base border border-border-subtle text-text-primary rounded-lg focus:ring-stone-500 focus:border-stone-500 block p-2.5"
                  >
                    <option value="en">English</option>
                    <option value="zh-CN">绠€浣撲腑鏂?/option>
                  </select>
                  <p className="text-sm text-text-muted">{text.appearance.applicationLanguageHelp}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-4 bg-bg-surface rounded-xl border border-border-subtle">
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="font-medium text-text-primary">{text.appearance.themeMode}</h4>
                    <p className="text-sm text-text-muted">{text.appearance.themeModeHelp}</p>
                  </div>
                  <ThemeToggle />
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {activeTab === 'about' && (
              <div className="space-y-6">
                <h3 className="text-lg font-medium text-text-primary mb-4">{text.about.sectionTitle}</h3>
                <div className="prose prose-sm text-text-secondary">
                  <p>
                    <strong>SlideTutor AI</strong> is an intelligent slide learning assistant. It combines advanced large language model technology to help you understand and learn PDF presentations more efficiently.
                  </p>
                  <h4 className="text-text-primary font-medium mt-4 mb-2">Core Features</h4>
                  <ul className="list-disc pl-5 space-y-1">
                    <li><strong>Smart Explanations:</strong> Automatically analyzes the content of each slide, divides knowledge points and generates detailed explanations.</li>
                    <li><strong>Interactive Q&A:</strong> Ask the AI questions about the slide content and get instant answers.</li>
                    <li><strong>Quiz Generation:</strong> Automatically generate quizzes related to the current page to help consolidate your knowledge.</li>
                    <li><strong>Eyecare Mode:</strong> Specially designed eyecare color palette for long reading sessions to protect your vision.</li>
                  </ul>
                  <h4 className="text-text-primary font-medium mt-4 mb-2">Basic Usage</h4>
                  <ol className="list-decimal pl-5 space-y-1">
                    <li>Click the folder icon in the top right corner to upload your PDF presentation.</li>
                    <li>Read the slides in the left panel, and click "Analyze" in the right panel to generate explanations.</li>
                    <li>Use the tabs at the top of the right panel to switch between Learn,and Ask You.</li>
                    <li>In the "follow-up", you can ask the AI a question on specific knowledge point.</li>
                  </ol>
                  <h4 className="text-text-primary font-medium mt-4 mb-2">Join Us</h4>
                  <p>
                    This is a newborn project. If you are interested in building fun products, please contact us at <a href="mailto:cutemengqiqi@gmail.com" className="text-text-secondary hover:underline">cutemengqiqi@gmail.com</a>.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {activeTab === 'feedback' && (
              <div className="space-y-5">
                <h3 className="text-lg font-medium text-text-primary mb-2">{text.feedback.sectionTitle}</h3>
                
                {submitStatus === 'success' ? (
                  <div className="bg-green-50 border border-green-200 rounded-xl p-6 text-center">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-12 h-12 text-green-500 mx-auto mb-3" />
                    <h4 className="text-lg font-medium text-green-800 mb-1">{applicationLanguage === 'zh-CN' ? '鍙嶉宸叉彁浜? : 'Feedback Submitted'}</h4>
                    <p className="text-green-600">{applicationLanguage === 'zh-CN' ? '鎰熻阿浣犵殑鏀寔涓庡弽棣堬紒' : 'Thank you for your support and feedback!'}</p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="space-y-4">
                    {submitStatus === 'error' && (
                      <div className="bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-lg p-3 flex items-start gap-2 text-red-700 text-sm">
                        <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 shrink-0" />
                        <p>{submitErrorMessage}</p>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {/* 鍙嶉绫诲瀷 */}
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-text-secondary mb-2">
                        {applicationLanguage === 'zh-CN' ? '鍙嶉绫诲瀷' : 'Feedback Type'} <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                      </label>
                      <div className="flex gap-4">
                        <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                          <input 
                            type="radio" 
                            name="feedbackType" 
                            value="suggestion"
                            checked={feedbackType === 'suggestion'}
                            onChange={() => setFeedbackType('suggestion')}
                            className="text-stone-600 focus:ring-stone-500"
                          />
                          <span className="text-sm text-text-secondary">{applicationLanguage === 'zh-CN' ? '寤鸿' : 'Suggestion'}</span>
                        </label>
                        <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                          <input 
                            type="radio" 
                            name="feedbackType" 
                            value="bug"
                            checked={feedbackType === 'bug'}
                            onChange={() => setFeedbackType('bug')}
                            className="text-stone-600 focus:ring-stone-500"
                          />
                          <span className="text-sm text-text-secondary">{applicationLanguage === 'zh-CN' ? '闂' : 'Bug'}</span>
                        </label>
                      </div>
                      {errors.type && <p className="text-red-500 text-xs mt-1">{errors.type}</p>}
                    </div>

                    {/* 鍘熷洜 */}
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-text-secondary mb-2">
                        Detailed Description <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                      </label>
                      <textarea
                        value={feedbackReason}
                        onChange={(e) => setFeedbackReason(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="Please describe your suggestion or the bug you encountered in detail"
                        className={`w-full bg-bg-surface border ${errors.reason ? 'border-red-300 focus:ring-red-500 focus:border-red-500' : 'border-border-subtle focus:ring-stone-500 focus:border-stone-500'} text-text-primary rounded-lg p-3 min-h-[120px] resize-y`}
                      />
                      {errors.reason && <p className="text-red-500 text-xs mt-1">{errors.reason}</p>}
                    </div>

                    {/* 鎴浘 */}
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-text-secondary mb-2">
                        Screenshots (Optional, up to 3)
                      </label>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                        {feedbackImages.map((img, idx) => (
                          <div key={idx} className="relative w-20 h-20 rounded-lg border border-border-subtle overflow-hidden group">
                            <img src={img} alt={`Screenshot ${idx + 1}`} className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                            <button
                              onClick={() => removeImage(idx)}
                              className="absolute top-1 right-1 bg-black/50 text-white rounded-full p-0.5 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"
                            >
                              <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                        {feedbackImages.length < 3 && (
                          <label className="w-20 h-20 rounded-lg border-2 border-dashed border-stone-300 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-stone-400 hover:text-stone-500 hover:border-stone-300 hover:bg-bg-surface cursor-pointer transition-colors">
                            <Upload className="w-5 h-5 mb-1" />
                            <span className="text-[10px]">Upload</span>
                            <input 
                              type="file" 
                              accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/gif" 
                              multiple 
                              className="hidden" 
                              onChange={handleImageUpload}
                            />
                          </label>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      {errors.images && <p className="text-red-500 text-xs mt-1">{errors.images}</p>}
                    </div>

                    {/* 鏄惁鍚屾剰鍚庣画鑱旂郴 */}
                    <div>
                      <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                        <input 
                          type="checkbox" 
                          checked={contactAgreed}
                          onChange={(e) => setContactAgreed(e.target.checked)}
                          className="rounded text-stone-600 focus:ring-stone-500"
                        />
                        <span className="text-sm text-text-secondary">Do you agree to be contacted via email regarding this feedback?</span>
                      </label>
                    </div>

                    {/* 鐢ㄦ埛閭 */}
                    {contactAgreed && (
                      <div>
                        <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-text-secondary mb-2">
                          Email Address <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                        </label>
                        <input
                          type="email"
                          value={userEmail}
                          onChange={(e) => setUserEmail(e.target.value)}
                          placeholder="Please enter your email address"
                          className={`w-full bg-bg-surface border ${errors.email ? 'border-red-300 focus:ring-red-500 focus:border-red-500' : 'border-border-subtle focus:ring-stone-500 focus:border-stone-500'} text-text-primary rounded-lg p-2.5`}
                        />
                        {errors.email && <p className="text-red-500 text-xs mt-1">{errors.email}</p>}
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {/* 鎸夐挳 */}
                    <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-4 border-t border-border-subtle">
                      <button
                        onClick={onClose}
                        disabled={isSubmitting}
                        className="px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-text-secondary bg-bg-base border border-border-strong rounded-lg hover:bg-bg-surface disabled:opacity-50"
                      >
                        {applicationLanguage === 'zh-CN' ? '鍙栨秷' : 'Cancel'}
                      </button>
                      <button
                        onClick={submitFeedback}
                        disabled={isSubmitting}
                        className="px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-stone-50 bg-stone-800 rounded-lg hover:bg-stone-900 flex items-center gap-2 disabled:opacity-50"
                      >
                        {isSubmitting ? (
                          <>
                            <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                            {applicationLanguage === 'zh-CN' ? '鎻愪氦涓?..' : 'Submitting...'}
                          </>
                        ) : (
                          applicationLanguage === 'zh-CN' ? '鎻愪氦' : 'Submit'
                        )}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <BuyCreditsDialog
        isOpen={buyCreditsDialogOpen}
        onClose={closeBuyCreditsDialog}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

import { create } from 'zustand';
import {
  AccessMode,
  AiAccessSettings,
  DEFAULT_AI_ACCESS_SETTINGS,
  DEFAULT_MODEL_CAPABILITY_CHECK,
  DEFAULT_SELECTED_MODEL,
  ModelCapabilityCheck,
  ModelCapabilitySelection,
  SelectedModel,
  normalizeAccessMode,
  normalizeAiAccessSettings,
  normalizeModelCapabilityCheck,
  normalizeSelectedModel,
} from '../config/models';
import { getSetting, setSetting } from '../lib/db';
import type { ApplicationLanguage } from '../lib/i18n/settingsText';

export type Theme = 'light' | 'eyecare' | 'twilight-zen' | 'spring-meadow';

const THEME_CLASSES = [
  'light',
  'dark',
  'eyecare',
  'twilight-zen',
  'spring-meadow',
  'windowsill',
  'rainy',
] as const;

const THEME_COLOR_META_PREFIX = 'slidetutor-theme-color-';
const DEFAULT_THEME_COLOR = '#F5F5F0';

function readThemeColor(theme: Theme) {
  const specificMeta = document.querySelector<HTMLMetaElement>(
    `meta[name="${THEME_COLOR_META_PREFIX}${theme}"]`
  );
  if (specificMeta?.content) return specificMeta.content;

  const fallbackMeta = document.querySelector<HTMLMetaElement>(
    `meta[name="${THEME_COLOR_META_PREFIX}light"]`
  );
  return fallbackMeta?.content || DEFAULT_THEME_COLOR;
}

function updateMetaThemeColor(theme: Theme) {
  try {
    let metaThemeColor = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');
    if (!metaThemeColor) {
      metaThemeColor = document.createElement('meta');
      metaThemeColor.setAttribute('name', 'theme-color');
      document.head.appendChild(metaThemeColor);
    }
    metaThemeColor.setAttribute('content', readThemeColor(theme));
  } catch (e) {}
}

interface UiState {
  isSettingsOpen: boolean;
  setIsSettingsOpen: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
  
  settingsTab: 'ai' | 'appearance' | 'about' | 'feedback';
  setSettingsTab: (tab: 'ai' | 'appearance' | 'about' | 'feedback') => void;
  
  isLibraryOpen: boolean;
  setIsLibraryOpen: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
  
  selectedModel: SelectedModel;
  setSelectedModel: (model: SelectedModel) => void;
  
  aiAccess: AiAccessSettings;
  setAiAccess: (access: AiAccessSettings) => void;

  modelCapabilityCheck: ModelCapabilityCheck;
  setModelCapabilityCheck: (check: ModelCapabilityCheck) => void;

  accessMode: AccessMode;
  setAccessMode: (mode: AccessMode) => void;

  hostedCreditsBalance: {
    balance: number;
    starterCredits: number;
    currency: 'credits';
  } | null;
  setHostedCreditsBalance: (
    balance: {
      balance: number;
      starterCredits: number;
      currency: 'credits';
    } | null
  ) => void;

  insufficientCreditsDialog: {
    action: 'analyze' | 'followup' | 'card_regenerate' | 'quiz.generate' | 'quiz.evaluate';
    requiredCredits: number;
    currentBalance: number;
  } | null;
  openInsufficientCreditsDialog: (dialog: NonNullable<UiState['insufficientCreditsDialog']>) => void;
  closeInsufficientCreditsDialog: () => void;
  
  outputLanguage: string;
  setOutputLanguage: (lang: string) => void;

  applicationLanguage: ApplicationLanguage;
  setApplicationLanguage: (lang: ApplicationLanguage) => void;

  theme: Theme;
  setTheme: (theme: Theme) => void;

  hoveredChunkId: string | null;
  setHoveredChunkId: (id: string | null) => void;
  
  hoveredNoteId: string | null;
  setHoveredNoteId: (id: string | null) => void;

  init: () => Promise<void>;
}

function toCapabilitySelection(model: SelectedModel): ModelCapabilitySelection {
  return {
    providerId: model.providerId,
    modelId: model.modelId,
    endpointPreset: model.providerId === 'openai-compatible' ? model.endpointPreset || 'qwen' : undefined,
  };
}

function invalidateCapabilityCheck(
  current: ModelCapabilityCheck,
  selection: ModelCapabilitySelection,
): ModelCapabilityCheck {
  return normalizeModelCapabilityCheck({
    ...current,
    status: current.selection ? 'stale' : 'pending',
    selection,
  });
}

export const useUiStore = create<UiState>((set, get) => ({
  isSettingsOpen: false,
  setIsSettingsOpen: (isOpen) => set({ isSettingsOpen: isOpen }),
  
  settingsTab: 'ai',
  setSettingsTab: (tab) => set({ settingsTab: tab }),
  
  isLibraryOpen: false,
  setIsLibraryOpen: (isOpen) => set({ isLibraryOpen: isOpen }),
  
  selectedModel: DEFAULT_SELECTED_MODEL,
  setSelectedModel: (model) => {
    const normalizedModel = normalizeSelectedModel(model);
    const nextCapabilityCheck = invalidateCapabilityCheck(
      get().modelCapabilityCheck,
      toCapabilitySelection(normalizedModel),
    );
    setSetting('slide_tutor_model', normalizedModel);
    setSetting('slide_tutor_model_capability', nextCapabilityCheck);
    set({
      selectedModel: normalizedModel,
      modelCapabilityCheck: nextCapabilityCheck,
    });
  },

  aiAccess: DEFAULT_AI_ACCESS_SETTINGS,
  setAiAccess: (access) => {
    const normalizedAccess = normalizeAiAccessSettings(access);
    const nextCapabilityCheck = invalidateCapabilityCheck(
      get().modelCapabilityCheck,
      toCapabilitySelection(get().selectedModel),
    );
    setSetting('slide_tutor_ai_access', normalizedAccess);
    setSetting('slide_tutor_model_capability', nextCapabilityCheck);
    set({
      aiAccess: normalizedAccess,
      modelCapabilityCheck: nextCapabilityCheck,
    });
  },

  modelCapabilityCheck: DEFAULT_MODEL_CAPABILITY_CHECK,
  setModelCapabilityCheck: (check) => {
    const normalizedCheck = normalizeModelCapabilityCheck(check);
    setSetting('slide_tutor_model_capability', normalizedCheck);
    set({ modelCapabilityCheck: normalizedCheck });
  },

  accessMode: 'byok',
  setAccessMode: (mode) => {
    const normalizedMode = normalizeAccessMode(mode);
    setSetting('slide_tutor_access_mode', normalizedMode);
    set({ accessMode: normalizedMode });
  },

  hostedCreditsBalance: null,
  setHostedCreditsBalance: (hostedCreditsBalance) => set({ hostedCreditsBalance }),

  insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
  openInsufficientCreditsDialog: (insufficientCreditsDialog) => set({ insufficientCreditsDialog }),
  closeInsufficientCreditsDialog: () => set({ insufficientCreditsDialog: null }),
  
  outputLanguage: (() => {
    const lang = navigator.language.toLowerCase();
    if (lang.startsWith('zh')) return 'Chinese';
    return 'English';
  })(),
  setOutputLanguage: (lang) => {
    setSetting('slide_tutor_language', lang);
    set({ outputLanguage: lang });
  },

  applicationLanguage: (() => {
    const lang = navigator.language.toLowerCase();
    if (lang.startsWith('zh')) return 'zh-CN' as const;
    return 'en' as const;
  })(),
  setApplicationLanguage: (lang) => {
    setSetting('slide_tutor_app_language', lang);
    set({ applicationLanguage: lang });
  },

  theme: 'light',
  setTheme: (theme) => {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.classList.remove(...THEME_CLASSES);
    root.classList.add(theme);
    setSetting('theme', theme);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('theme', theme);
      updateMetaThemeColor(theme);
    } catch (e) {}
    set({ theme });
  },

  hoveredChunkId: null,
  setHoveredChunkId: (id) => set({ hoveredChunkId: id }),
  
  hoveredNoteId: null,
  setHoveredNoteId: (id) => set({ hoveredNoteId: id }),

  init: async () => {
    const savedModel = normalizeSelectedModel(
      await getSetting<SelectedModel>('slide_tutor_model', DEFAULT_SELECTED_MODEL)
    );
    const savedAiAccess = normalizeAiAccessSettings(
      await getSetting<AiAccessSettings>('slide_tutor_ai_access', DEFAULT_AI_ACCESS_SETTINGS)
    );
    const savedModelCapabilityCheck = normalizeModelCapabilityCheck(
      await getSetting<ModelCapabilityCheck>('slide_tutor_model_capability', DEFAULT_MODEL_CAPABILITY_CHECK)
    );
    const savedAccessMode = normalizeAccessMode(
      await getSetting<AccessMode>('slide_tutor_access_mode', 'byok')
    );
    
    const defaultLang = navigator.language.toLowerCase().startsWith('zh') ? 'Chinese' : 'English';
    const savedLang = await getSetting<string>('slide_tutor_language', defaultLang);
    const defaultAppLanguage = navigator.language.toLowerCase().startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
    const savedAppLanguage = await getSetting<ApplicationLanguage>('slide_tutor_app_language', defaultAppLanguage);

    const savedTheme = await getSetting<Theme>('theme', 'light');
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.classList.remove(...THEME_CLASSES);
    root.classList.add(savedTheme);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('theme', savedTheme);
      updateMetaThemeColor(savedTheme);
    } catch (e) {}

    set({ 
      selectedModel: savedModel,
      aiAccess: savedAiAccess,
      modelCapabilityCheck: savedModelCapabilityCheck,
      accessMode: savedAccessMode,
      outputLanguage: savedLang,
      applicationLanguage: savedAppLanguage,
      theme: savedTheme
    });
  }
}));

  const isLibraryOpen = useUiStore(state => state.isLibraryOpen);
  const setIsLibraryOpen = useUiStore(state => state.setIsLibraryOpen);
  const isSettingsOpen = useUiStore(state => state.isSettingsOpen);
  const setIsSettingsOpen = useUiStore(state => state.setIsSettingsOpen);
  
  const fileName = usePdfStore(state => state.fileName);
  const fileUrl = usePdfStore(state => state.fileUrl);

  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  return (
    <header className="h-14 bg-bg-surface border-b border-border-subtle flex items-center justify-between px-4 shrink-0 z-30 shadow-sm">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
        <button
          onClick={() => setIsLibraryOpen(!isLibraryOpen)}
          className={`p-2 rounded-lg transition-colors ${
            isLibraryOpen 
              ? 'header-toggle-active' 
              : 'text-text-secondary hover:bg-bg-base hover:text-text-primary'
          }`}
          title="Toggle Library"
        >
          <Library className="w-5 h-5" />
        </button>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="header-brand-badge w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm">
            <GraduationCap className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <h1 className="font-semibold text-text-primary tracking-tight">SlideTutor AI</h1>
        </div>
        
        {fileName && (
          <div className="hidden md:flex items-center gap-3 ml-4 pl-4 border-l border-border-subtle">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium text-text-secondary truncate max-w-[300px]" title={fileName}>
              {fileName}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        {fileUrl && (
          <div className="mr-2">
            <GlobalAnalysisButton />
          </div>
        )}
        <input 
          type="file" 
          accept="application/pdf" 
          className="hidden" 
          ref={fileInputRef}
          onChange={onFileUpload}
        />
        <button 
          onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
          className="header-accent-button flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-medium transition-colors shadow-sm cursor-pointer text-sm mr-2"
        >
          <Upload className="w-4 h-4" />
          {fileUrl ? 'Change PDF' : 'Upload PDF'}
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={onFeedbackClick}
          className="p-2 text-text-secondary hover:text-text-primary hover:bg-bg-base rounded-lg transition-colors"
          title="Feedback"
        >
          <MessageSquarePlus className="w-5 h-5" />
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setIsSettingsOpen(true)}
          className="p-2 text-text-secondary hover:text-text-primary hover:bg-bg-base rounded-lg transition-colors"
          title="Settings"
        >
          <Settings className="w-5 h-5" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}

import { cloudflare } from '@cloudflare/vite-plugin';
import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
import path from 'path';
import { defineConfig, loadEnv } from 'vite';
import { configDefaults } from 'vitest/config';

export default defineConfig(({ mode }) => {
  const env = loadEnv(mode, '.', '');
  const plugins = [react(), tailwindcss()];

  if (!process.env.VITEST) {
    plugins.unshift(cloudflare());
  }

  return {
    // Support both Vite-style and Next-style public env names during the migration to Clerk auth.
    envPrefix: ['VITE_', 'NEXT_PUBLIC_'],
    plugins,
    resolve: {
      alias: {
        '@': path.resolve(__dirname, '.'),
      },
    },
    build: {
      rollupOptions: {
        output: {
          assetFileNames: (assetInfo) => {
            if (assetInfo.names && assetInfo.names.some((name) => name.endsWith('.mjs'))) {
              return 'assets/[name]-[hash].js';
            }

            return 'assets/[name]-[hash][extname]';
          },
        },
      },
    },
    server: {
      // HMR is disabled in AI Studio via DISABLE_HMR env var.
      hmr: process.env.DISABLE_HMR !== 'true',
      watch: {
        // Ignore Wrangler runtime state so local D1 writes do not trigger reload loops.
        ignored: ['**/.wrangler/**'],
      },
    },
    test: {
      globals: true,
      environment: 'jsdom',
      setupFiles: './src/test/setup.ts',
      exclude: [...configDefaults.exclude, 'test/workers/**/*.test.ts'],
    },
  };
});

+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import App from './App';
+import { usePdfStore } from './store/pdfStore';
+import { useTutorStore } from './store/tutorStore';
+import { useUiStore } from './store/uiStore';
+
+const savePDFMock = vi.fn();
+const migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock = vi.fn();
+
+vi.mock('./lib/db', () => ({
+  savePDF: savePDFMock,
+  updatePDFState: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFTags: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFLastPage: vi.fn(),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./lib/migrate', () => ({
+  migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDB: migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock,
+}));
+
+vi.mock('uuid', () => ({
+  v4: () => 'pdf-test-id',
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/PdfViewer', () => ({
+  PdfViewer: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="pdf-viewer" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CanvasTutor', () => ({
+  CanvasTutor: vi.fn(({ children }) => <div data-testid="canvas-tutor">{children}</div>),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/AskYouTutor', () => ({
+  AskYouTutor: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="ask-you-tutor" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Sidebar/LibrarySidebar', () => ({
+  LibrarySidebar: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="library-sidebar" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CreditsRequiredDialog', () => ({
+  CreditsRequiredDialog: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({
+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Header/AppHeader', () => ({
+  AppHeader: vi.fn(({ onFileUpload }) => (
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({
+          target: {
+            files: [new File(['%PDF-1.4'], 'chapter-1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })],
+            value: '',
+          },
+        } as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>)
+      }
+    >
+      Trigger Upload
+    </button>
+  )),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useSlideAnalysis', () => ({
+  useSlideAnalysis: vi.fn(() => ({
+    explainSlide: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useFollowUp', () => ({
+  useFollowUp: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleSendMessage: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleRegenerateFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useNotes', () => ({
+  useNotes: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleAddNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleConvertSpatialNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleMoveNote: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useQuiz', () => ({
+  useQuiz: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleGenerateQuestions: vi.fn(),
+    handleAnswersChange: vi.fn(),
+    handleSubmitAnswers: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useChunkRegenerate', () => ({
+  useChunkRegenerate: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleRegenerateChunk: vi.fn(),
+    regeneratingChunks: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/usePdfLibrary', () => ({
+  usePdfLibrary: vi.fn(() => ({
+    loadPdfFromDb: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeletePdf: vi.fn(),
+    loadSavedPdfs: vi.fn(),
+    savedPdfs: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+
+    usePdfStore.setState({
+      fileUrl: null,
+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,
+      pageNumber: 1,
+      leftWidth: 50,
+    } as any);
+
+    useTutorStore.setState({
+      pagesState: {},
+      mode: 'learn',
+      isGeneratingAskYou: false,
+      isSubmittingAskYou: false,
+      isAutoAnalyzing: false,
+      globalAnalysisStatus: 'idle',
+      globalProgress: { current: 0, total: 0, failedPages: [] },
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+  });
+
+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';

+import { usePdfStore } from './store/pdfStore';
+import { useTutorStore } from './store/tutorStore';
+import { useUiStore } from './store/uiStore';
+
+const savePDFMock = vi.fn();
+const migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock = vi.fn();
+
+vi.mock('./lib/db', () => ({
+  savePDF: savePDFMock,
+  updatePDFState: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFTags: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFLastPage: vi.fn(),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./lib/migrate', () => ({
+  migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDB: migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock,
+}));
+
+vi.mock('uuid', () => ({
+  v4: () => 'pdf-test-id',
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/PdfViewer', () => ({
+  PdfViewer: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="pdf-viewer" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CanvasTutor', () => ({
+  CanvasTutor: vi.fn(({ children }) => <div data-testid="canvas-tutor">{children}</div>),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/AskYouTutor', () => ({
+  AskYouTutor: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="ask-you-tutor" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Sidebar/LibrarySidebar', () => ({
+  LibrarySidebar: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="library-sidebar" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CreditsRequiredDialog', () => ({
+  CreditsRequiredDialog: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({
+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Header/AppHeader', () => ({
+  AppHeader: vi.fn(({ onFileUpload }) => (
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({
+          target: {
+            files: [new File(['%PDF-1.4'], 'chapter-1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })],
+            value: '',
+          },
+        } as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>)
+      }
+    >
+      Trigger Upload
+    </button>
+  )),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useSlideAnalysis', () => ({
+  useSlideAnalysis: vi.fn(() => ({
+    explainSlide: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useFollowUp', () => ({
+  useFollowUp: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleSendMessage: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleRegenerateFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useNotes', () => ({
+  useNotes: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleAddNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleConvertSpatialNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleMoveNote: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useQuiz', () => ({
+  useQuiz: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleGenerateQuestions: vi.fn(),
+    handleAnswersChange: vi.fn(),
+    handleSubmitAnswers: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useChunkRegenerate', () => ({
+  useChunkRegenerate: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleRegenerateChunk: vi.fn(),
+    regeneratingChunks: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/usePdfLibrary', () => ({
+  usePdfLibrary: vi.fn(() => ({
+    loadPdfFromDb: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeletePdf: vi.fn(),
+    loadSavedPdfs: vi.fn(),
+    savedPdfs: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+
+    usePdfStore.setState({
+      fileUrl: null,
+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,
+      pageNumber: 1,
+      leftWidth: 50,
+    } as any);
+
+    useTutorStore.setState({
+      pagesState: {},
+      mode: 'learn',
+      isGeneratingAskYou: false,
+      isSubmittingAskYou: false,
+      isAutoAnalyzing: false,
+      globalAnalysisStatus: 'idle',
+      globalProgress: { current: 0, total: 0, failedPages: [] },
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+  });
+
+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { getHostedCreditsBalance } from '../../lib/api/apiClient';
import { usePlatformAuth } from '../../lib/auth/clerk';
import { PLATFORM_ACTION_PRICING } from '../../lib/platformAccess/pricing';
import { useUiStore } from '../../store/uiStore';
import { getSettingsUIText, type ApplicationLanguage } from '../../lib/i18n/settingsText';
import { InfoTrigger } from '../ui/InfoTrigger';

type PlatformApiSectionProps = {
  onOpenBuyCredits: () => void;
};

const PLATFORM_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE =
  'Platform API sign-in is temporarily unavailable on this deployment.';

export function PlatformApiSection({ onOpenBuyCredits }: PlatformApiSectionProps) {
  const accessMode = useUiStore((state) => state.accessMode);
  const applicationLanguage = useUiStore((state) => state.applicationLanguage);
  const setAccessMode = useUiStore((state) => state.setAccessMode);
  const hostedCreditsBalance = useUiStore((state) => state.hostedCreditsBalance);
  const setHostedCreditsBalance = useUiStore((state) => state.setHostedCreditsBalance);
  const {
    isAvailable,
    isLoaded,
    isSignedIn,
    userEmail,
    requirePlatformSignIn,
    signOut,
  } = usePlatformAuth();
  const [balanceError, setBalanceError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [authStatusMessage, setAuthStatusMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const text = getSettingsUIText(applicationLanguage as ApplicationLanguage);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isAvailable || accessMode !== 'platform') {
      return;
    }

    setAccessMode('byok');
    setAuthStatusMessage(PLATFORM_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE);
  }, [accessMode, isAvailable, setAccessMode]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (accessMode !== 'platform' || !isSignedIn) {
      return;
    }

    let cancelled = false;

    getHostedCreditsBalance()
      .then((balance) => {
        if (cancelled) {
          return;
        }

        setHostedCreditsBalance(balance);
        setBalanceError(null);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (cancelled) {
          return;
        }

        setBalanceError('Failed to load hosted credits.');
      });

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [accessMode, isSignedIn, setHostedCreditsBalance]);

  const handleModeChange = async (nextMode: 'byok' | 'platform') => {
    if (nextMode === 'byok') {
      setAuthStatusMessage(null);
      setAccessMode('byok');
      return;
    }

    if (!isAvailable) {
      setAuthStatusMessage(PLATFORM_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE);
      return;
    }

    if (!isLoaded) {
      setAuthStatusMessage(
        'Platform sign-in is still loading. Check your Clerk publishable key or domain setup if this does not resolve shortly.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (!isSignedIn) {
      setAuthStatusMessage(null);
      await requirePlatformSignIn();
      return;
    }

    setAuthStatusMessage(null);
    setAccessMode('platform');
  };

  return (
    <section className="rounded-xl border border-border-subtle bg-bg-surface p-4 space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <h4 className="font-medium text-text-primary">{text.ai.accessMode}</h4>
        <InfoTrigger
          placement="bottom"
          content={
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <p>{text.ai.accessModeInfoPrimary}</p>
              <p>{text.ai.accessModeInfoSecondary}</p>
            </div>
          }
        />
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            void handleModeChange('byok');
          }}
          className={`rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-left transition-colors ${
            accessMode === 'byok'
              ? 'border-stone-700 bg-stone-50 text-stone-950'
              : 'border-border-subtle bg-bg-base text-text-secondary hover:bg-bg-surface'
          }`}
        >
          <div className="font-medium">{text.ai.myApi}</div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">
            {text.ai.myApiHelp}
          </div>
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            void handleModeChange('platform');
          }}
          className={`rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-left transition-colors ${
            accessMode === 'platform'
              ? 'border-stone-700 bg-stone-50 text-stone-950'
              : 'border-border-subtle bg-bg-base text-text-secondary hover:bg-bg-surface'
          }`}
        >
          <div className="font-medium">{text.ai.platformApi}</div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">
            {text.ai.platformApiHelp}
          </div>
        </button>
      </div>

      {authStatusMessage && <p className="text-sm text-amber-700">{authStatusMessage}</p>}

      {accessMode === 'platform' && (
        <div className="space-y-0 rounded-xl border border-border-subtle bg-bg-base transition-all duration-200">
          {/* Account Section */}
          <div className="px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-bg-surface/30 rounded-t-xl">
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <div className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold text-text-muted mb-0.5">{text.ai.platformAccount}</div>
              <div 
                className="text-sm text-text-primary truncate font-medium" 
                title={isSignedIn && userEmail ? userEmail : undefined}
              >
                {isSignedIn && userEmail ? userEmail : text.ai.accountNotSignedIn}
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                void (isSignedIn ? signOut() : requirePlatformSignIn());
              }}
              className="shrink-0 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-text-muted hover:text-text-primary hover:bg-bg-surface rounded-md border border-transparent hover:border-border-subtle transition-all"
            >
              {isSignedIn ? text.ai.signOut : text.ai.signIn}
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Divider */}
          <div className="h-[1px] bg-border-subtle/50 mx-4" />

          {/* Credits Section */}
          <div className="px-4 py-4 flex flex-col gap-2 relative z-10">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <div className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold text-text-muted">{text.ai.creditsBalance}</div>
              <InfoTrigger
                placement="bottom"
                align="start"
                content={
                  <div className="space-y-1.5">
                    <p className="font-semibold mb-1 border-b border-border-subtle pb-1">{text.ai.platformCreditsUsage}</p>
                    <div className="flex justify-between gap-4"><span>{applicationLanguage === 'zh-CN' ? '鍒嗘瀽锛? : 'Analyze:'}</span> <span className="font-medium">{PLATFORM_ACTION_PRICING.analyze} {applicationLanguage === 'zh-CN' ? '棰濆害' : 'credits'}</span></div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between gap-4"><span>{applicationLanguage === 'zh-CN' ? '杩介棶锛? : 'Follow-up:'}</span> <span className="font-medium">{PLATFORM_ACTION_PRICING.followup} {applicationLanguage === 'zh-CN' ? '棰濆害' : 'credit'}</span></div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between gap-4"><span>{applicationLanguage === 'zh-CN' ? '鍗＄墖閲嶇敓鎴愶細' : 'Card regenerate:'}</span> <span className="font-medium">{PLATFORM_ACTION_PRICING.card_regenerate} {applicationLanguage === 'zh-CN' ? '棰濆害' : 'credit'}</span></div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between gap-4"><span>{applicationLanguage === 'zh-CN' ? '娴嬮獙鐢熸垚锛? : 'Quiz generation:'}</span> <span className="font-medium">{PLATFORM_ACTION_PRICING.generate_questions} {applicationLanguage === 'zh-CN' ? '棰濆害' : 'credit'}</span></div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between gap-4"><span>{applicationLanguage === 'zh-CN' ? '绛旀鍒嗘瀽锛? : 'Answer analysis:'}</span> <span className="font-medium">{PLATFORM_ACTION_PRICING.evaluate_answers} {applicationLanguage === 'zh-CN' ? '棰濆害' : 'credit'}</span></div>
                  </div>
                }
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-end justify-between gap-4">
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-text-primary">
                {hostedCreditsBalance ? (
                  <>
                    <span className="sr-only">{hostedCreditsBalance.balance} credits</span>
                    <span className="flex items-baseline gap-1" aria-hidden="true">
                      {hostedCreditsBalance.balance}
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-text-muted uppercase tracking-wider"> credits</span>
                    </span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  '--'
                )}
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onOpenBuyCredits}
                className="h-10 px-4 rounded-lg bg-stone-900 text-stone-50 text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-stone-800 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all shadow-sm flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"
              >
                {text.ai.buyCredits}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Status Messages */}
          {(balanceError || !isSignedIn) && (
            <div className="px-4 pb-3 space-y-1">
              {!isSignedIn && (
                <p className="text-[11px] text-amber-700 flex items-center gap-1">
                  {text.ai.signInRequiredForPlatform}
                </p>
              )}
              {balanceError && (
                <p className="text-[11px] text-red-600 flex items-center gap-1">
                  {balanceError}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

import { create } from 'zustand';
import { PageState } from '../types';
import { getSetting, setSetting } from '../lib/db';

interface TutorState {
  pagesState: Record<number, PageState>;
  setPagesState: (updater: (prev: Record<number, PageState>) => Record<number, PageState>) => void;
  updatePageState: (pageNumber: number, updater: (prevState: PageState) => Partial<PageState>) => void;
  
  mode: 'learn' | 'askYou';
  setMode: (mode: 'learn' | 'askYou') => void;
  
  isGeneratingAskYou: boolean;
  setIsGeneratingAskYou: (isGenerating: boolean) => void;
  
  isSubmittingAskYou: boolean;
  setIsSubmittingAskYou: (isSubmitting: boolean) => void;
  
  isAutoAnalyzing: boolean;
  setIsAutoAnalyzing: (isAutoAnalyzing: boolean) => void;
  
  globalAnalysisStatus: 'idle' | 'analyzing' | 'paused' | 'completed' | 'error';
  setGlobalAnalysisStatus: (status: 'idle' | 'analyzing' | 'paused' | 'completed' | 'error') => void;
  
  globalProgress: { current: number; total: number; failedPages: number[] };
  setGlobalProgress: (updater: (prev: { current: number; total: number; failedPages: number[] }) => { current: number; total: number; failedPages: number[] }) => void;
  
  autoAnalyzePage: number;
  setAutoAnalyzePage: (page: number) => void;
  
  isFocusMode: boolean;
  setIsFocusMode: (isFocus: boolean) => void;
  
  abortController: AbortController | null;
  setAbortController: (controller: AbortController | null) => void;
  cancelAnalysis: () => void;

  init: () => Promise<void>;
}

export const useTutorStore = create<TutorState>((set, get) => ({
  pagesState: {},
  setPagesState: (updater) => set((state) => ({ pagesState: updater(state.pagesState) })),
  updatePageState: (pageNumber, updater) => set((state) => {
    const prevState = state.pagesState[pageNumber] || {
      isExplaining: false,
      followUps: [],
      notes: {},
      activeProbeContext: null
    };
    const updates = updater(prevState);

    if ('explanationArtifact' in updates && !updates.explanationArtifact) {
      updates.activeProbeContext = null;
    }

    return {
      pagesState: {
        ...state.pagesState,
        [pageNumber]: {
          ...prevState,
          ...updates
        }
      }
    };
  }),
  
  mode: 'learn',
  setMode: (mode) => set({ mode }),
  
  isGeneratingAskYou: false,
  setIsGeneratingAskYou: (isGenerating) => set({ isGeneratingAskYou: isGenerating }),
  
  isSubmittingAskYou: false,
  setIsSubmittingAskYou: (isSubmitting) => set({ isSubmittingAskYou: isSubmitting }),
  
  isAutoAnalyzing: false,
  setIsAutoAnalyzing: (isAutoAnalyzing) => set({ isAutoAnalyzing }),
  
  globalAnalysisStatus: 'idle',
  setGlobalAnalysisStatus: (status) => set({ globalAnalysisStatus: status }),
  
  globalProgress: { current: 0, total: 0, failedPages: [] },
  setGlobalProgress: (updater) => set((state) => ({ globalProgress: updater(state.globalProgress) })),
  
  autoAnalyzePage: 0,
  setAutoAnalyzePage: (page) => set({ autoAnalyzePage: page }),
  
  isFocusMode: false,
  setIsFocusMode: (isFocus) => {
    setSetting('slide_tutor_focus_mode', isFocus);
    set({ isFocusMode: isFocus });
  },

  abortController: null,
  setAbortController: (controller) => set({ abortController: controller }),
  cancelAnalysis: () => {
    const { abortController } = get();
    if (abortController) {
      abortController.abort();
      set({ abortController: null, isAutoAnalyzing: false, globalAnalysisStatus: 'paused' });
    }
  },

  init: async () => {
    const savedFocus = await getSetting<boolean>('slide_tutor_focus_mode', false);
    set({ isFocusMode: savedFocus });
  }
}));

+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Info } from 'lucide-react';

interface InfoTriggerProps {
  content: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  placement?: 'top' | 'bottom';
  align?: 'start' | 'center' | 'end';
}

export const InfoTrigger: React.FC<InfoTriggerProps> = ({ 
  content, 
  className = '', 
  placement = 'top',
  align = 'center'
}) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const timeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  const isTop = placement === 'top';
  
  const alignClass = align === 'start' ? 'left-0' : align === 'end' ? 'right-0' : 'left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2';
  const arrowClass = align === 'start' ? 'left-2' : align === 'end' ? 'right-2' : 'left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2';

  const handleMouseEnter = () => {
    if (timeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    setIsOpen(true);
  };

  const handleMouseLeave = () => {
    timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setIsOpen(false);
    }, 200);
  };

  const toggleOpen = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsOpen(!isOpen);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (containerRef.current && !containerRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };

    if (isOpen) {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    }
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

  return (
    <div 
      ref={containerRef}
      className={`relative inline-flex items-center align-middle ${className}`}
      onMouseEnter={handleMouseEnter}
      onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={toggleOpen}
        className="text-text-muted hover:text-text-primary transition-colors p-0.5 rounded-full focus:outline-none"
        aria-label="More information"
      >
        <Info className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
      </button>

      {isOpen && (
        <div 
          className={`absolute z-50 ${isTop ? 'bottom-full mb-2' : 'top-full mt-2'} ${alignClass} w-64 p-3 bg-white/95 dark:bg-stone-900/95 backdrop-blur-md border border-border-subtle shadow-xl rounded-xl text-xs leading-relaxed text-text-secondary animate-in fade-in zoom-in duration-200`}
          onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          {content}
          <div className={`absolute ${isTop ? '-bottom-1' : '-top-1'} ${arrowClass} w-2 h-2 bg-white dark:bg-stone-900 border-${isTop ? 'b' : 't'} border-${isTop ? 'r' : 'l'} border-border-subtle rotate-45`} />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

+        },

+      },

+    appHeader: {

+      uploadPdf: '上传 PDF',
+      changePdf: '更换 PDF',
+      feedback: '反馈',
+      settings: '设置',
+    },
+    uploadFlow: {
+      dropTitle: '拖拽 PDF 以上传',
+      dropDescription: '松开鼠标以上传演示文稿',
+      confirmTitle: '确认上传',
+      confirmDescription: (fileName) =>
+        `是否上传 “${fileName}”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。`,
+      cancel: '取消',

+      invalidFileAlert: '请上传 PDF 文件。',
+      uploadFailedAlert: '上传 PDF 失败。请检查浏览器存储空间是否已满。',
+    },

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

diff --git a/src/lib/i18n/index.ts b/src/lib/i18n/index.ts

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..7e2799d044edc1f640ee66e0b5d69df67f6db843
