+++ b/src/lib/i18n/index.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,454 @@
+export const SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES = ['en', 'zh-CN'] as const;
+
+export type ApplicationLanguage = (typeof SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES)[number];
+
+export const APPLICATION_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS: Array<{
+  value: ApplicationLanguage;
+  label: string;
+}> = [
+  { value: 'en', label: 'English' },
+  { value: 'zh-CN', label: '简体中文' },
+];
+
+export const OUTPUT_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS = [
+  { value: 'English', label: 'English' },
+  { value: 'Chinese', label: '中文 (Chinese)' },
+  { value: 'Spanish', label: 'Español (Spanish)' },
+  { value: 'French', label: 'Français (French)' },
+  { value: 'Japanese', label: '日本語 (Japanese)' },
+  { value: 'Korean', label: '한국어 (Korean)' },
+] as const;
+
+type UIText = {
+  settingsModal: {
+    modalTitle: string;
+    tabs: {
+      ai: string;
+      appearance: string;
+      about: string;

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import App from './App';
+import { usePdfStore } from './store/pdfStore';
+import { useTutorStore } from './store/tutorStore';
+import { useUiStore } from './store/uiStore';
+
+const savePDFMock = vi.fn();
+const migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock = vi.fn();
+
+vi.mock('./lib/db', () => ({
+  savePDF: savePDFMock,
+  updatePDFState: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFTags: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFLastPage: vi.fn(),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./lib/migrate', () => ({
+  migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDB: migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock,
+}));
+
+vi.mock('uuid', () => ({
+  v4: () => 'pdf-test-id',
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/PdfViewer', () => ({
+  PdfViewer: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="pdf-viewer" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CanvasTutor', () => ({
+  CanvasTutor: vi.fn(({ children }) => <div data-testid="canvas-tutor">{children}</div>),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/AskYouTutor', () => ({
+  AskYouTutor: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="ask-you-tutor" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Sidebar/LibrarySidebar', () => ({
+  LibrarySidebar: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="library-sidebar" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CreditsRequiredDialog', () => ({
+  CreditsRequiredDialog: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({
+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Header/AppHeader', () => ({
+  AppHeader: vi.fn(({ onFileUpload }) => (
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({
+          target: {
+            files: [new File(['%PDF-1.4'], 'chapter-1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })],
+            value: '',
+          },
+        } as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>)
+      }
+    >
+      Trigger Upload
+    </button>
+  )),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useSlideAnalysis', () => ({
+  useSlideAnalysis: vi.fn(() => ({
+    explainSlide: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useFollowUp', () => ({
+  useFollowUp: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleSendMessage: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleRegenerateFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useNotes', () => ({
+  useNotes: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleAddNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleConvertSpatialNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleMoveNote: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useQuiz', () => ({
+  useQuiz: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleGenerateQuestions: vi.fn(),
+    handleAnswersChange: vi.fn(),
+    handleSubmitAnswers: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useChunkRegenerate', () => ({
+  useChunkRegenerate: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleRegenerateChunk: vi.fn(),
+    regeneratingChunks: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/usePdfLibrary', () => ({
+  usePdfLibrary: vi.fn(() => ({
+    loadPdfFromDb: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeletePdf: vi.fn(),
+    loadSavedPdfs: vi.fn(),
+    savedPdfs: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+
+    usePdfStore.setState({
+      fileUrl: null,
+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,
+      pageNumber: 1,
+      leftWidth: 50,
+    } as any);
+
+    useTutorStore.setState({
+      pagesState: {},
+      mode: 'learn',
+      isGeneratingAskYou: false,
+      isSubmittingAskYou: false,
+      isAutoAnalyzing: false,
+      globalAnalysisStatus: 'idle',
+      globalProgress: { current: 0, total: 0, failedPages: [] },
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+  });
+
+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {

+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});

+    useUiStore.setState({

+  });

+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {

+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {

+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import App from './App';
+import { usePdfStore } from './store/pdfStore';
+import { useTutorStore } from './store/tutorStore';
+import { useUiStore } from './store/uiStore';
+
+const savePDFMock = vi.fn();
+const migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock = vi.fn();
+
+vi.mock('./lib/db', () => ({
+  savePDF: savePDFMock,
+  updatePDFState: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFTags: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFLastPage: vi.fn(),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./lib/migrate', () => ({
+  migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDB: migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock,
+}));
+
+vi.mock('uuid', () => ({
+  v4: () => 'pdf-test-id',
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/PdfViewer', () => ({
+  PdfViewer: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="pdf-viewer" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CanvasTutor', () => ({
+  CanvasTutor: vi.fn(({ children }) => <div data-testid="canvas-tutor">{children}</div>),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/AskYouTutor', () => ({
+  AskYouTutor: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="ask-you-tutor" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Sidebar/LibrarySidebar', () => ({
+  LibrarySidebar: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="library-sidebar" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CreditsRequiredDialog', () => ({
+  CreditsRequiredDialog: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({
+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Header/AppHeader', () => ({
+  AppHeader: vi.fn(({ onFileUpload }) => (
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({
+          target: {
+            files: [new File(['%PDF-1.4'], 'chapter-1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })],
+            value: '',
+          },
+        } as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>)
+      }
+    >
+      Trigger Upload
+    </button>
+  )),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useSlideAnalysis', () => ({
+  useSlideAnalysis: vi.fn(() => ({
+    explainSlide: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useFollowUp', () => ({
+  useFollowUp: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleSendMessage: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleRegenerateFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useNotes', () => ({
+  useNotes: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleAddNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleConvertSpatialNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleMoveNote: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useQuiz', () => ({
+  useQuiz: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleGenerateQuestions: vi.fn(),
+    handleAnswersChange: vi.fn(),
+    handleSubmitAnswers: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useChunkRegenerate', () => ({
+  useChunkRegenerate: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleRegenerateChunk: vi.fn(),
+    regeneratingChunks: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/usePdfLibrary', () => ({
+  usePdfLibrary: vi.fn(() => ({
+    loadPdfFromDb: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeletePdf: vi.fn(),
+    loadSavedPdfs: vi.fn(),
+    savedPdfs: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+
+    usePdfStore.setState({
+      fileUrl: null,
+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,
+      pageNumber: 1,
+      leftWidth: 50,
+    } as any);
+
+    useTutorStore.setState({
+      pagesState: {},
+      mode: 'learn',
+      isGeneratingAskYou: false,
+      isSubmittingAskYou: false,
+      isAutoAnalyzing: false,
+      globalAnalysisStatus: 'idle',
+      globalProgress: { current: 0, total: 0, failedPages: [] },
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+  });
+
+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';

+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));

+  AppHeader: vi.fn(({ onFileUpload }) => (
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({

+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {

+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {

+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+      uploadFailedAlert: '上传 PDF 失败。请检查浏览器存储空间是否已满。',
+    },
+  },
+};
+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

diff --git a/src/App.test.tsx b/src/App.test.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..9ee1cb9c4bcaf05f1057e442f5f4ba49d27b49b1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/App.test.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,191 @@
+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import App from './App';
+import { usePdfStore } from './store/pdfStore';
+import { useTutorStore } from './store/tutorStore';
+import { useUiStore } from './store/uiStore';
+
+const savePDFMock = vi.fn();
+const migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock = vi.fn();
+
+vi.mock('./lib/db', () => ({
+  savePDF: savePDFMock,
+  updatePDFState: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFTags: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFLastPage: vi.fn(),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./lib/migrate', () => ({
+  migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDB: migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock,
+}));
+
+vi.mock('uuid', () => ({
+  v4: () => 'pdf-test-id',
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/PdfViewer', () => ({
+  PdfViewer: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="pdf-viewer" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CanvasTutor', () => ({
+  CanvasTutor: vi.fn(({ children }) => <div data-testid="canvas-tutor">{children}</div>),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/AskYouTutor', () => ({
+  AskYouTutor: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="ask-you-tutor" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Sidebar/LibrarySidebar', () => ({
+  LibrarySidebar: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="library-sidebar" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CreditsRequiredDialog', () => ({
+  CreditsRequiredDialog: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({
+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Header/AppHeader', () => ({
+  AppHeader: vi.fn(({ onFileUpload }) => (
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({
+          target: {
+            files: [new File(['%PDF-1.4'], 'chapter-1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })],
+            value: '',
+          },
+        } as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>)
+      }
+    >
+      Trigger Upload
+    </button>
+  )),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useSlideAnalysis', () => ({
+  useSlideAnalysis: vi.fn(() => ({
+    explainSlide: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useFollowUp', () => ({
+  useFollowUp: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleSendMessage: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleRegenerateFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useNotes', () => ({
+  useNotes: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleAddNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleConvertSpatialNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleMoveNote: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useQuiz', () => ({
+  useQuiz: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleGenerateQuestions: vi.fn(),
+    handleAnswersChange: vi.fn(),
+    handleSubmitAnswers: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useChunkRegenerate', () => ({
+  useChunkRegenerate: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleRegenerateChunk: vi.fn(),
+    regeneratingChunks: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/usePdfLibrary', () => ({
+  usePdfLibrary: vi.fn(() => ({
+    loadPdfFromDb: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeletePdf: vi.fn(),
+    loadSavedPdfs: vi.fn(),
+    savedPdfs: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+
+    usePdfStore.setState({
+      fileUrl: null,
+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,
+      pageNumber: 1,
+      leftWidth: 50,
+    } as any);
+
+    useTutorStore.setState({
+      pagesState: {},
+      mode: 'learn',
+      isGeneratingAskYou: false,
+      isSubmittingAskYou: false,
+      isAutoAnalyzing: false,
+      globalAnalysisStatus: 'idle',
+      globalProgress: { current: 0, total: 0, failedPages: [] },
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+  });
+
+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+      }
+      if (key === 'slide_tutor_language') {
+        return 'English' as never;

+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import App from './App';
+import { usePdfStore } from './store/pdfStore';
+import { useTutorStore } from './store/tutorStore';
+import { useUiStore } from './store/uiStore';
+
+const savePDFMock = vi.fn();
+const migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock = vi.fn();
+
+vi.mock('./lib/db', () => ({
+  savePDF: savePDFMock,
+  updatePDFState: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFTags: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFLastPage: vi.fn(),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./lib/migrate', () => ({
+  migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDB: migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock,
+}));
+
+vi.mock('uuid', () => ({
+  v4: () => 'pdf-test-id',
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/PdfViewer', () => ({
+  PdfViewer: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="pdf-viewer" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CanvasTutor', () => ({
+  CanvasTutor: vi.fn(({ children }) => <div data-testid="canvas-tutor">{children}</div>),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/AskYouTutor', () => ({
+  AskYouTutor: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="ask-you-tutor" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Sidebar/LibrarySidebar', () => ({
+  LibrarySidebar: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="library-sidebar" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CreditsRequiredDialog', () => ({
+  CreditsRequiredDialog: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({
+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Header/AppHeader', () => ({
+  AppHeader: vi.fn(({ onFileUpload }) => (
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({
+          target: {
+            files: [new File(['%PDF-1.4'], 'chapter-1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })],
+            value: '',
+          },
+        } as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>)
+      }
+    >
+      Trigger Upload
+    </button>
+  )),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useSlideAnalysis', () => ({
+  useSlideAnalysis: vi.fn(() => ({
+    explainSlide: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useFollowUp', () => ({
+  useFollowUp: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleSendMessage: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleRegenerateFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useNotes', () => ({
+  useNotes: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleAddNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleConvertSpatialNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleMoveNote: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useQuiz', () => ({
+  useQuiz: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleGenerateQuestions: vi.fn(),
+    handleAnswersChange: vi.fn(),
+    handleSubmitAnswers: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useChunkRegenerate', () => ({
+  useChunkRegenerate: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleRegenerateChunk: vi.fn(),
+    regeneratingChunks: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/usePdfLibrary', () => ({
+  usePdfLibrary: vi.fn(() => ({
+    loadPdfFromDb: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeletePdf: vi.fn(),
+    loadSavedPdfs: vi.fn(),
+    savedPdfs: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+
+    usePdfStore.setState({
+      fileUrl: null,
+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,
+      pageNumber: 1,
+      leftWidth: 50,
+    } as any);
+
+    useTutorStore.setState({
+      pagesState: {},
+      mode: 'learn',
+      isGeneratingAskYou: false,
+      isSubmittingAskYou: false,
+      isAutoAnalyzing: false,
+      globalAnalysisStatus: 'idle',
+      globalProgress: { current: 0, total: 0, failedPages: [] },
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+  });
+
+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+};
+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

diff --git a/src/App.test.tsx b/src/App.test.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..9ee1cb9c4bcaf05f1057e442f5f4ba49d27b49b1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/App.test.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,191 @@
+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import App from './App';
+import { usePdfStore } from './store/pdfStore';
+import { useTutorStore } from './store/tutorStore';
+import { useUiStore } from './store/uiStore';
+
+const savePDFMock = vi.fn();
+const migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock = vi.fn();
+
+vi.mock('./lib/db', () => ({
+  savePDF: savePDFMock,
+  updatePDFState: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFTags: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFLastPage: vi.fn(),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./lib/migrate', () => ({
+  migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDB: migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock,
+}));
+
+vi.mock('uuid', () => ({
+  v4: () => 'pdf-test-id',
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/PdfViewer', () => ({
+  PdfViewer: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="pdf-viewer" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CanvasTutor', () => ({
+  CanvasTutor: vi.fn(({ children }) => <div data-testid="canvas-tutor">{children}</div>),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/AskYouTutor', () => ({
+  AskYouTutor: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="ask-you-tutor" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Sidebar/LibrarySidebar', () => ({
+  LibrarySidebar: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="library-sidebar" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CreditsRequiredDialog', () => ({
+  CreditsRequiredDialog: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({
+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Header/AppHeader', () => ({
+  AppHeader: vi.fn(({ onFileUpload }) => (
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({
+          target: {
+            files: [new File(['%PDF-1.4'], 'chapter-1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })],
+            value: '',
+          },
+        } as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>)
+      }
+    >
+      Trigger Upload
+    </button>
+  )),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useSlideAnalysis', () => ({
+  useSlideAnalysis: vi.fn(() => ({
+    explainSlide: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useFollowUp', () => ({
+  useFollowUp: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleSendMessage: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleRegenerateFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useNotes', () => ({
+  useNotes: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleAddNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleConvertSpatialNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleMoveNote: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useQuiz', () => ({
+  useQuiz: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleGenerateQuestions: vi.fn(),
+    handleAnswersChange: vi.fn(),
+    handleSubmitAnswers: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useChunkRegenerate', () => ({
+  useChunkRegenerate: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleRegenerateChunk: vi.fn(),
+    regeneratingChunks: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/usePdfLibrary', () => ({
+  usePdfLibrary: vi.fn(() => ({
+    loadPdfFromDb: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeletePdf: vi.fn(),
+    loadSavedPdfs: vi.fn(),
+    savedPdfs: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+
+    usePdfStore.setState({
+      fileUrl: null,
+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,
+      pageNumber: 1,
+      leftWidth: 50,
+    } as any);
+
+    useTutorStore.setState({
+      pagesState: {},
+      mode: 'learn',
+      isGeneratingAskYou: false,
+      isSubmittingAskYou: false,
+      isAutoAnalyzing: false,
+      globalAnalysisStatus: 'idle',
+      globalProgress: { current: 0, total: 0, failedPages: [] },
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+  });
+
+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+};
+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import App from './App';
+import { usePdfStore } from './store/pdfStore';
+import { useTutorStore } from './store/tutorStore';
+import { useUiStore } from './store/uiStore';
+
+const savePDFMock = vi.fn();
+const migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock = vi.fn();
+
+vi.mock('./lib/db', () => ({
+  savePDF: savePDFMock,
+  updatePDFState: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFTags: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFLastPage: vi.fn(),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./lib/migrate', () => ({
+  migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDB: migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock,
+}));
+
+vi.mock('uuid', () => ({
+  v4: () => 'pdf-test-id',
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/PdfViewer', () => ({
+  PdfViewer: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="pdf-viewer" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CanvasTutor', () => ({
+  CanvasTutor: vi.fn(({ children }) => <div data-testid="canvas-tutor">{children}</div>),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/AskYouTutor', () => ({
+  AskYouTutor: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="ask-you-tutor" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Sidebar/LibrarySidebar', () => ({
+  LibrarySidebar: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="library-sidebar" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CreditsRequiredDialog', () => ({
+  CreditsRequiredDialog: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({
+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Header/AppHeader', () => ({
+  AppHeader: vi.fn(({ onFileUpload }) => (
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({
+          target: {
+            files: [new File(['%PDF-1.4'], 'chapter-1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })],
+            value: '',
+          },
+        } as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>)
+      }
+    >
+      Trigger Upload
+    </button>
+  )),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useSlideAnalysis', () => ({
+  useSlideAnalysis: vi.fn(() => ({
+    explainSlide: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useFollowUp', () => ({
+  useFollowUp: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleSendMessage: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleRegenerateFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useNotes', () => ({
+  useNotes: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleAddNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleConvertSpatialNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleMoveNote: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useQuiz', () => ({
+  useQuiz: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleGenerateQuestions: vi.fn(),
+    handleAnswersChange: vi.fn(),
+    handleSubmitAnswers: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useChunkRegenerate', () => ({
+  useChunkRegenerate: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleRegenerateChunk: vi.fn(),
+    regeneratingChunks: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/usePdfLibrary', () => ({
+  usePdfLibrary: vi.fn(() => ({
+    loadPdfFromDb: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeletePdf: vi.fn(),
+    loadSavedPdfs: vi.fn(),
+    savedPdfs: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+
+    usePdfStore.setState({
+      fileUrl: null,
+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,
+      pageNumber: 1,
+      leftWidth: 50,
+    } as any);
+
+    useTutorStore.setState({
+      pagesState: {},
+      mode: 'learn',
+      isGeneratingAskYou: false,
+      isSubmittingAskYou: false,
+      isAutoAnalyzing: false,
+      globalAnalysisStatus: 'idle',
+      globalProgress: { current: 0, total: 0, failedPages: [] },
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+  });
+
+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

diff --git a/src/App.test.tsx b/src/App.test.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..9ee1cb9c4bcaf05f1057e442f5f4ba49d27b49b1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/App.test.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,191 @@
+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import App from './App';
+import { usePdfStore } from './store/pdfStore';
+import { useTutorStore } from './store/tutorStore';
+import { useUiStore } from './store/uiStore';
+
+const savePDFMock = vi.fn();
+const migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock = vi.fn();
+
+vi.mock('./lib/db', () => ({
+  savePDF: savePDFMock,
+  updatePDFState: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFTags: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFLastPage: vi.fn(),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./lib/migrate', () => ({
+  migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDB: migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock,
+}));
+
+vi.mock('uuid', () => ({
+  v4: () => 'pdf-test-id',
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/PdfViewer', () => ({
+  PdfViewer: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="pdf-viewer" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CanvasTutor', () => ({
+  CanvasTutor: vi.fn(({ children }) => <div data-testid="canvas-tutor">{children}</div>),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/AskYouTutor', () => ({
+  AskYouTutor: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="ask-you-tutor" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Sidebar/LibrarySidebar', () => ({
+  LibrarySidebar: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="library-sidebar" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CreditsRequiredDialog', () => ({
+  CreditsRequiredDialog: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({
+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Header/AppHeader', () => ({
+  AppHeader: vi.fn(({ onFileUpload }) => (
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({
+          target: {
+            files: [new File(['%PDF-1.4'], 'chapter-1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })],
+            value: '',
+          },
+        } as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>)
+      }
+    >
+      Trigger Upload
+    </button>
+  )),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useSlideAnalysis', () => ({
+  useSlideAnalysis: vi.fn(() => ({
+    explainSlide: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useFollowUp', () => ({
+  useFollowUp: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleSendMessage: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleRegenerateFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useNotes', () => ({
+  useNotes: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleAddNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleConvertSpatialNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleMoveNote: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useQuiz', () => ({
+  useQuiz: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleGenerateQuestions: vi.fn(),
+    handleAnswersChange: vi.fn(),
+    handleSubmitAnswers: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useChunkRegenerate', () => ({
+  useChunkRegenerate: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleRegenerateChunk: vi.fn(),
+    regeneratingChunks: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/usePdfLibrary', () => ({
+  usePdfLibrary: vi.fn(() => ({
+    loadPdfFromDb: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeletePdf: vi.fn(),
+    loadSavedPdfs: vi.fn(),
+    savedPdfs: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+
+    usePdfStore.setState({
+      fileUrl: null,
+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,
+      pageNumber: 1,
+      leftWidth: 50,
+    } as any);
+
+    useTutorStore.setState({
+      pagesState: {},
+      mode: 'learn',
+      isGeneratingAskYou: false,
+      isSubmittingAskYou: false,
+      isAutoAnalyzing: false,
+      globalAnalysisStatus: 'idle',
+      globalProgress: { current: 0, total: 0, failedPages: [] },
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+  });
+
+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { X, MessageSquare, Info, Palette, Cpu, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, Upload, Loader2, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { ThemeToggle } from './ThemeToggle';
import { BuyCreditsDialog } from './settings/BuyCreditsDialog';
import { PlatformApiSection } from './settings/PlatformApiSection';
import {
  SelectedModel,
  ProviderId,
  MODEL_CONFIG,
  OpenAiCompatibleEndpointPreset,
  getOpenAiCompatibleBaseURL,
} from '../config/models';
import { useUiStore } from '../store/uiStore';
import { checkModelCapability } from '../lib/api/apiClient';
import { getSettingsUIText, type ApplicationLanguage } from '../lib/i18n/settingsText';

import { InfoTrigger } from './ui/InfoTrigger';

interface SettingsModalProps {
// ... existing props ...
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  selectedModel: SelectedModel;
  setSelectedModel: (model: SelectedModel) => void;
  outputLanguage: string;
  setOutputLanguage: (lang: string) => void;
  isBuyCreditsDialogOpen?: boolean;
  onOpenBuyCredits?: () => void;
  onCloseBuyCredits?: () => void;
}

export const SettingsModal: React.FC<SettingsModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  selectedModel,
  setSelectedModel,
  outputLanguage,
  setOutputLanguage,
  isBuyCreditsDialogOpen,
  onOpenBuyCredits,
  onCloseBuyCredits,
}) => {
  const activeTab = useUiStore(state => state.settingsTab);
  const setActiveTab = useUiStore(state => state.setSettingsTab);
  const aiAccess = useUiStore(state => state.aiAccess);
  const accessMode = useUiStore(state => state.accessMode);
  const applicationLanguage = useUiStore(state => state.applicationLanguage);
  const setApplicationLanguage = useUiStore(state => state.setApplicationLanguage);
  const modelCapabilityCheck = useUiStore(state => state.modelCapabilityCheck);
  const setAiAccess = useUiStore(state => state.setAiAccess);
  const setModelCapabilityCheck = useUiStore(state => state.setModelCapabilityCheck);
  const [feedbackType, setFeedbackType] = useState<'suggestion' | 'bug' | null>(null);
  const [feedbackReason, setFeedbackReason] = useState('');
  const [feedbackImages, setFeedbackImages] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [contactAgreed, setContactAgreed] = useState(false);
  const [userEmail, setUserEmail] = useState('');
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [submitStatus, setSubmitStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'success' | 'error'>('idle');
  const [submitErrorMessage, setSubmitErrorMessage] = useState('Failed to submit feedback. Please try again later.');
  const [localBuyCreditsDialogOpen, setLocalBuyCreditsDialogOpen] = useState(false);

  const buyCreditsDialogOpen = isBuyCreditsDialogOpen ?? localBuyCreditsDialogOpen;
  const openBuyCreditsDialog = onOpenBuyCredits ?? (() => setLocalBuyCreditsDialogOpen(true));
  const closeBuyCreditsDialog = onCloseBuyCredits ?? (() => setLocalBuyCreditsDialogOpen(false));
  const text = getSettingsUIText(applicationLanguage as ApplicationLanguage);

  const selectedEndpointPreset =
    selectedModel.providerId === 'openai-compatible' ? selectedModel.endpointPreset || 'qwen' : undefined;

  const selectedModelValue =
    selectedModel.providerId === 'openai-compatible'
      ? `openai-compatible|${selectedEndpointPreset}|${selectedModel.modelId}`
      : `gemini|default|${selectedModel.modelId}`;

  const updateOpenAiAccess = (updater: (current: typeof aiAccess.openAiCompatible) => typeof aiAccess.openAiCompatible) => {
    setAiAccess({
      ...aiAccess,
      openAiCompatible: updater(aiAccess.openAiCompatible),
    });
  };

  const updateParserAccess = (updater: (current: typeof aiAccess.parser) => typeof aiAccess.parser) => {
    setAiAccess({
      ...aiAccess,
      parser: updater(aiAccess.parser),
    });
  };

  const handleModelSelectionChange = (rawValue: string) => {
    const [providerId, endpointPresetValue, modelId] = rawValue.split('|');

    if (providerId === 'openai-compatible') {
      const endpointPreset = endpointPresetValue as OpenAiCompatibleEndpointPreset;
      setSelectedModel({
        providerId: 'openai-compatible',
        endpointPreset,
        modelId,
      });

      updateOpenAiAccess((current) => ({
        ...current,
        endpointPreset,
        baseURL: endpointPreset === 'custom' ? current.baseURL : getOpenAiCompatibleBaseURL(endpointPreset),
      }));
      return;
    }

    setSelectedModel({
      providerId: providerId as ProviderId,
      modelId,
    });
  };

  const byokConfigReady =
    accessMode === 'byok' &&
    (selectedModel.providerId === 'gemini'
      ? aiAccess.gemini.apiKey.trim().length > 0
      : aiAccess.openAiCompatible.apiKey.trim().length > 0 &&
        aiAccess.openAiCompatible.baseURL.trim().length > 0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen || accessMode !== 'byok' || !byokConfigReady) {
      return;
    }

    let cancelled = false;
    const selection = {
      providerId: selectedModel.providerId,
      modelId: selectedModel.modelId,
      endpointPreset: selectedModel.providerId === 'openai-compatible' ? selectedEndpointPreset : undefined,
    };

    setModelCapabilityCheck({
      ...modelCapabilityCheck,
      status: 'checking',
      selection,
    });

    const timeoutId = window.setTimeout(() => {
      checkModelCapability({
        providerId: selectedModel.providerId,
        modelId: selectedModel.modelId,
        endpointPreset: selectedModel.providerId === 'openai-compatible' ? selectedEndpointPreset : undefined,
      })
        .then((result) => {
          if (cancelled) {
            return;
          }

          setModelCapabilityCheck({
            ...result,
            selection,
          });
        })
        .catch(() => {
          if (cancelled) {
            return;
          }

          setModelCapabilityCheck({
            status: 'pending',
            checkedAt: null,
            lastErrorCode: 'MODEL_CAPABILITY_CHECK_FAILED',
            capabilitySummary: null,
            selection,
          });
        });
    }, 150);

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    };
  }, [
    accessMode,
    aiAccess.gemini.apiKey,
    aiAccess.openAiCompatible.apiKey,
    aiAccess.openAiCompatible.baseURL,
    byokConfigReady,
    isOpen,
    selectedEndpointPreset,
    selectedModel.modelId,
    selectedModel.providerId,
  ]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleImageUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const files = e.target.files;
    if (!files) return;

    const newErrors = { ...errors };
    delete newErrors.images;

    if (feedbackImages.length + files.length > 3) {
      newErrors.images = 'You can only upload up to 3 images';
      setErrors(newErrors);
      return;
    }

    const newImages: string[] = [];
    let hasError = false;

    Array.from(files).forEach(file => {
      if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif'].includes(file.type)) {
        newErrors.images = 'Only JPG, PNG, and GIF formats are supported';
        hasError = true;
        return;
      }
      if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
        newErrors.images = 'Each image must be smaller than 5MB';
        hasError = true;
        return;
      }

      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = (e) => {
        if (e.target?.result) {
          setFeedbackImages(prev => [...prev, e.target!.result as string]);

 succeeded in 3141ms:
        }
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    });

    if (hasError) {
      setErrors(newErrors);
    }
  };

  const removeImage = (index: number) => {
    setFeedbackImages(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  };

  const validateFeedback = () => {
    const newErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
    if (!feedbackType) newErrors.type = 'Please select a feedback type';
    if (!feedbackReason.trim()) newErrors.reason = 'Please describe your suggestion or the bug you encountered';
    if (contactAgreed) {
      if (!userEmail.trim()) {
        newErrors.email = 'Please enter your email address';
      } else if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(userEmail)) {
        newErrors.email = 'Please enter a valid email address';
      }
    }
    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  };

  const submitFeedback = async () => {
    if (!validateFeedback()) return;

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setSubmitStatus('idle');
    setSubmitErrorMessage('Failed to submit feedback. Please try again later.');

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/feedback', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          type: feedbackType === 'suggestion' ? 'Suggestion' : 'Bug',
          reason: feedbackReason,
          images: feedbackImages,
          contactAgreed,
          email: userEmail,
        }),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        const errorData = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(errorData.error || 'Submission failed');
      }

      setSubmitStatus('success');
      setTimeout(() => {
        onClose();
        // Reset form
        setFeedbackType(null);
        setFeedbackReason('');
        setFeedbackImages([]);
        setContactAgreed(false);
        setUserEmail('');
        setSubmitStatus('idle');
      }, 2000);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Feedback error:', error);
      setSubmitErrorMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to submit feedback. Please try again later.');
      setSubmitStatus('error');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4">
      <div className="bg-bg-elevated rounded-xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden border border-border-subtle">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 border-b border-border-subtle shrink-0">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-text-primary">{text.modalTitle}</h2>
          <button 
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-text-muted hover:text-text-secondary p-1 rounded-md hover:bg-bg-surface transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex flex-1 overflow-hidden">
          {/* Sidebar */}
          <div className="w-56 bg-bg-surface border-r border-border-subtle p-4 space-y-2 shrink-0 overflow-y-auto">
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('ai')}
              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${activeTab === 'ai' ? 'bg-bg-base text-text-primary' : 'text-text-secondary hover:bg-bg-base'}`}
            >
              <Cpu className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              {text.tabs.ai}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('appearance')}
              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${activeTab === 'appearance' ? 'bg-bg-base text-text-primary' : 'text-text-secondary hover:bg-bg-base'}`}
            >
              <Palette className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              {text.tabs.appearance}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('about')}
              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${activeTab === 'about' ? 'bg-bg-base text-text-primary' : 'text-text-secondary hover:bg-bg-base'}`}
            >
              <Info className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              {text.tabs.about}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('feedback')}
              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${activeTab === 'feedback' ? 'bg-bg-base text-text-primary' : 'text-text-secondary hover:bg-bg-base'}`}

+    handleConvertSpatialNote: vi.fn(),

+    handleAnswersChange: vi.fn(),
+    handleSubmitAnswers: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useChunkRegenerate', () => ({
+  useChunkRegenerate: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleRegenerateChunk: vi.fn(),
+    regeneratingChunks: [],
+  })),
+}));

+vi.mock('./hooks/usePdfLibrary', () => ({

+    loadPdfFromDb: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeletePdf: vi.fn(),
+    loadSavedPdfs: vi.fn(),
+    savedPdfs: [],
+  })),
+}));

+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),

+    usePdfStore.setState({

+      currentPdfId: null,

+      isSubmittingAskYou: false,
+      isAutoAnalyzing: false,
+      globalAnalysisStatus: 'idle',
+      globalProgress: { current: 0, total: 0, failedPages: [] },
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+  });
+
+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({

+            files: [new File(['%PDF-1.4'], 'chapter-1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })],
+            value: '',

+}));

+    handleDeleteFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleRegenerateFollowUp: vi.fn(),

+vi.mock('./hooks/useNotes', () => ({

+    handleDeleteNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleConvertSpatialNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleMoveNote: vi.fn(),

+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useQuiz', () => ({

+    handleGenerateQuestions: vi.fn(),
+    handleAnswersChange: vi.fn(),
+    handleSubmitAnswers: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useChunkRegenerate', () => ({
+  useChunkRegenerate: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleRegenerateChunk: vi.fn(),
+    regeneratingChunks: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/usePdfLibrary', () => ({

+    loadPdfFromDb: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeletePdf: vi.fn(),
+    loadSavedPdfs: vi.fn(),
+    savedPdfs: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+
+    usePdfStore.setState({
+      fileUrl: null,
+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,
+      pageNumber: 1,
+      leftWidth: 50,

+
+    useTutorStore.setState({
+      pagesState: {},
+      mode: 'learn',
+      isGeneratingAskYou: false,
+      isSubmittingAskYou: false,
+      isAutoAnalyzing: false,
+      globalAnalysisStatus: 'idle',
+      globalProgress: { current: 0, total: 0, failedPages: [] },
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+  });
+
+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';

+

+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+

+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',

+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),

+
+    usePdfStore.setState({

+      },

+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();

+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+export const SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES = ['en', 'zh-CN'] as const;
+
+export type ApplicationLanguage = (typeof SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES)[number];
+
+export const APPLICATION_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS: Array<{
+  value: ApplicationLanguage;
+  label: string;
+}> = [
+  { value: 'en', label: 'English' },
+  { value: 'zh-CN', label: '简体中文' },
+];
+
+export const OUTPUT_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS = [
+  { value: 'English', label: 'English' },
+  { value: 'Chinese', label: '中文 (Chinese)' },
+  { value: 'Spanish', label: 'Español (Spanish)' },
+  { value: 'French', label: 'Français (French)' },
+  { value: 'Japanese', label: '日本語 (Japanese)' },
+  { value: 'Korean', label: '한국어 (Korean)' },
+] as const;
+

+      platformApiHelp: string;
+      platformUnavailable: string;
+      platformLoading: string;
+      hostedCreditsLoadFailed: string;
+      selectModel: string;

+      myApiCredentialsHelp: string;
+      geminiApiKey: string;
+      endpointPreset: string;
+      qwenPreset: string;
+      doubaoPreset: string;
+      customOpenAiCompatible: string;
+      openAiCompatibleApiKey: string;
+      baseUrl: string;
+      modelId: string;
+      optionalParser: string;
+      optionalParserHelp: string;
+      parserProvider: string;
+      noParserDegraded: string;
+      llamaParseApiKey: string;
+      checkingCompatibility: string;
+      modelReady: string;
+      modelUnusable: string;
+      compatibilityPending: string;
+      compatibilityStale: string;
+      outputLanguage: string;
+      outputLanguageHelp: string;
+      accountNotSignedIn: string;
+      signIn: string;
+      signOut: string;
+      buyCredits: string;
+      creditsBalance: string;

+      platformCreditsUsage: string;
+      signInRequiredForPlatform: string;

+        analyze: string;

+      themeModeHelp: string;

+      intro: string;
+      coreFeaturesTitle: string;
+      coreFeatures: string[];
+      basicUsageTitle: string;
+      basicUsage: string[];

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

+import { useUiStore } from './store/uiStore';
+
+const savePDFMock = vi.fn();

+  savePDF: savePDFMock,

+  updatePDFLastPage: vi.fn(),
+}));

+vi.mock('./lib/migrate', () => ({
+  migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDB: migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock,
+}));
+
+vi.mock('uuid', () => ({
+  v4: () => 'pdf-test-id',
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/PdfViewer', () => ({
+  PdfViewer: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="pdf-viewer" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CanvasTutor', () => ({
+  CanvasTutor: vi.fn(({ children }) => <div data-testid="canvas-tutor">{children}</div>),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/AskYouTutor', () => ({
+  AskYouTutor: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="ask-you-tutor" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Sidebar/LibrarySidebar', () => ({
+  LibrarySidebar: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="library-sidebar" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CreditsRequiredDialog', () => ({
+  CreditsRequiredDialog: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({
+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Header/AppHeader', () => ({
+  AppHeader: vi.fn(({ onFileUpload }) => (
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({
+          target: {
+            files: [new File(['%PDF-1.4'], 'chapter-1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })],
+            value: '',
+          },
+        } as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>)

+    >
+      Trigger Upload

+  )),

+vi.mock('./hooks/useSlideAnalysis', () => ({
+  useSlideAnalysis: vi.fn(() => ({
+    explainSlide: vi.fn(),

+}));

+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),

+
+    usePdfStore.setState({
+      fileUrl: null,
+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,

+    useTutorStore.setState({

+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {

+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();

+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));

+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+export const SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES = ['en', 'zh-CN'] as const;
+
+export type ApplicationLanguage = (typeof SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES)[number];
+
+export const APPLICATION_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS: Array<{
+  value: ApplicationLanguage;
+  label: string;
+}> = [
+  { value: 'en', label: 'English' },
+  { value: 'zh-CN', label: '简体中文' },
+];
+
+export const OUTPUT_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS = [
+  { value: 'English', label: 'English' },
+  { value: 'Chinese', label: '中文 (Chinese)' },
+  { value: 'Spanish', label: 'Español (Spanish)' },
+  { value: 'French', label: 'Français (French)' },
+  { value: 'Japanese', label: '日本語 (Japanese)' },
+  { value: 'Korean', label: '한국어 (Korean)' },
+] as const;
+
+type UIText = {
+  settingsModal: {
+    modalTitle: string;
+    tabs: {
+      ai: string;
+      appearance: string;
+      about: string;
+      feedback: string;
+    };
+    ai: {
+      sectionTitle: string;
+      accessMode: string;
+      accessModeInfoPrimary: string;
+      accessModeInfoSecondary: string;
+      myApi: string;
+      myApiHelp: string;
+      platformApi: string;
+      platformApiHelp: string;
+      platformUnavailable: string;
+      platformLoading: string;
+      hostedCreditsLoadFailed: string;
+      selectModel: string;
+      myApiCredentials: string;
+      myApiCredentialsHelp: string;
+      geminiApiKey: string;
+      endpointPreset: string;
+      qwenPreset: string;
+      doubaoPreset: string;
+      customOpenAiCompatible: string;
+      openAiCompatibleApiKey: string;
+      baseUrl: string;
+      modelId: string;
+      optionalParser: string;

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}
