+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({

+    handleEditFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleRegenerateFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useNotes', () => ({

+    handleDeleteNote: vi.fn(),

+    handleAnswersChange: vi.fn(),
+    handleSubmitAnswers: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+

+    handleRegenerateChunk: vi.fn(),
+    regeneratingChunks: [],

+}));

+vi.mock('./hooks/usePdfLibrary', () => ({

+    savedPdfs: [],
+  })),
+}));

+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {

+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',

+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',

+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),

+
+    usePdfStore.setState({

+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,
+      pageNumber: 1,

+

+      isAutoAnalyzing: false,

+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+  });

+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+          uploadLimit: '最多只能上传 3 张图片。',

+          typeRequired: '请选择反馈类型。',
+          reasonRequired: '请填写你的建议，或描述你遇到的问题。',
+          emailRequired: '请输入邮箱地址。',
+          emailInvalid: '请输入有效的邮箱地址。',
+        },
+        screenshotAlt: (index) => `截图 ${index}`,
+      },
+    },
+    appHeader: {
+      toggleLibrary: '切换资料库',
+      uploadPdf: '上传 PDF',
+      changePdf: '更换 PDF',
+      feedback: '反馈',
+      settings: '设置',
+    },
+    uploadFlow: {
+      dropTitle: '拖拽 PDF 以上传',
+      dropDescription: '松开鼠标以上传演示文稿',
+      confirmTitle: '确认上传',
+      confirmDescription: (fileName) =>
+        `是否上传 “${fileName}”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。`,
+      cancel: '取消',
+      uploadNow: '立即上传',
+      invalidFileAlert: '请上传 PDF 文件。',
+      uploadFailedAlert: '上传 PDF 失败。请检查浏览器存储空间是否已满。',
+    },
+  },
+};
+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import App from './App';
+import { usePdfStore } from './store/pdfStore';
+import { useTutorStore } from './store/tutorStore';
+import { useUiStore } from './store/uiStore';
+
+const savePDFMock = vi.fn();
+const migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock = vi.fn();
+
+vi.mock('./lib/db', () => ({
+  savePDF: savePDFMock,
+  updatePDFState: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFTags: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFLastPage: vi.fn(),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./lib/migrate', () => ({
+  migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDB: migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock,
+}));
+
+vi.mock('uuid', () => ({
+  v4: () => 'pdf-test-id',
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/PdfViewer', () => ({
+  PdfViewer: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="pdf-viewer" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CanvasTutor', () => ({
+  CanvasTutor: vi.fn(({ children }) => <div data-testid="canvas-tutor">{children}</div>),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/AskYouTutor', () => ({
+  AskYouTutor: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="ask-you-tutor" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Sidebar/LibrarySidebar', () => ({
+  LibrarySidebar: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="library-sidebar" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CreditsRequiredDialog', () => ({
+  CreditsRequiredDialog: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({
+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Header/AppHeader', () => ({
+  AppHeader: vi.fn(({ onFileUpload }) => (
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({
+          target: {
+            files: [new File(['%PDF-1.4'], 'chapter-1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })],
+            value: '',
+          },
+        } as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>)
+      }
+    >
+      Trigger Upload
+    </button>
+  )),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useSlideAnalysis', () => ({
+  useSlideAnalysis: vi.fn(() => ({
+    explainSlide: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useFollowUp', () => ({
+  useFollowUp: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleSendMessage: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleRegenerateFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useNotes', () => ({
+  useNotes: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleAddNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleConvertSpatialNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleMoveNote: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useQuiz', () => ({
+  useQuiz: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleGenerateQuestions: vi.fn(),
+    handleAnswersChange: vi.fn(),
+    handleSubmitAnswers: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useChunkRegenerate', () => ({
+  useChunkRegenerate: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleRegenerateChunk: vi.fn(),
+    regeneratingChunks: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/usePdfLibrary', () => ({
+  usePdfLibrary: vi.fn(() => ({
+    loadPdfFromDb: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeletePdf: vi.fn(),
+    loadSavedPdfs: vi.fn(),
+    savedPdfs: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+
+    usePdfStore.setState({
+      fileUrl: null,
+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,
+      pageNumber: 1,
+      leftWidth: 50,
+    } as any);
+
+    useTutorStore.setState({
+      pagesState: {},
+      mode: 'learn',
+      isGeneratingAskYou: false,
+      isSubmittingAskYou: false,
+      isAutoAnalyzing: false,
+      globalAnalysisStatus: 'idle',
+      globalProgress: { current: 0, total: 0, failedPages: [] },
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+  });
+
+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

+import { useUiStore } from './store/uiStore';
+
+const savePDFMock = vi.fn();

+  updatePDFLastPage: vi.fn(),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./lib/migrate', () => ({
+  migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDB: migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock,
+}));
+
+vi.mock('uuid', () => ({
+  v4: () => 'pdf-test-id',
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/PdfViewer', () => ({
+  PdfViewer: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="pdf-viewer" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CanvasTutor', () => ({
+  CanvasTutor: vi.fn(({ children }) => <div data-testid="canvas-tutor">{children}</div>),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/AskYouTutor', () => ({
+  AskYouTutor: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="ask-you-tutor" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Sidebar/LibrarySidebar', () => ({
+  LibrarySidebar: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="library-sidebar" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CreditsRequiredDialog', () => ({
+  CreditsRequiredDialog: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({
+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Header/AppHeader', () => ({
+  AppHeader: vi.fn(({ onFileUpload }) => (
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({
+          target: {
+            files: [new File(['%PDF-1.4'], 'chapter-1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })],
+            value: '',
+          },

+vi.mock('./hooks/useSlideAnalysis', () => ({

+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',

+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,

+    usePdfStore.setState({

+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+const savePDFMock = vi.fn();

+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+        screenshotsLabel: '截图（可选，最多 3 张）',
+        upload: '上传',
+        contactAgreement: '是否同意我们通过邮箱就这条反馈继续联系你？',
+        emailLabel: '邮箱地址',
+        emailPlaceholder: '请输入你的邮箱地址',
+        cancel: '取消',
+        submit: '提交',
+        submitting: '提交中...',
+        errors: {
+          uploadLimit: '最多只能上传 3 张图片。',
+          unsupportedImageType: '仅支持 JPG、PNG 和 GIF 格式。',
+          imageTooLarge: '每张图片必须小于 5MB。',
+          typeRequired: '请选择反馈类型。',
+          reasonRequired: '请填写你的建议，或描述你遇到的问题。',
+          emailRequired: '请输入邮箱地址。',
+          emailInvalid: '请输入有效的邮箱地址。',
+        },
+        screenshotAlt: (index) => `截图 ${index}`,
+      },
+    },
+    appHeader: {
+      toggleLibrary: '切换资料库',
+      uploadPdf: '上传 PDF',
+      changePdf: '更换 PDF',
+      feedback: '反馈',
+      settings: '设置',
+    },
+    uploadFlow: {
+      dropTitle: '拖拽 PDF 以上传',
+      dropDescription: '松开鼠标以上传演示文稿',
+      confirmTitle: '确认上传',
+      confirmDescription: (fileName) =>
+        `是否上传 “${fileName}”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。`,
+      cancel: '取消',
+      uploadNow: '立即上传',
+      invalidFileAlert: '请上传 PDF 文件。',
+      uploadFailedAlert: '上传 PDF 失败。请检查浏览器存储空间是否已满。',
+    },

+};
+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');

+});

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,191 @@
+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import App from './App';
+import { usePdfStore } from './store/pdfStore';
+import { useTutorStore } from './store/tutorStore';
+import { useUiStore } from './store/uiStore';
+
+const savePDFMock = vi.fn();
+const migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock = vi.fn();
+
+vi.mock('./lib/db', () => ({
+  savePDF: savePDFMock,
+  updatePDFState: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFTags: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFLastPage: vi.fn(),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./lib/migrate', () => ({
+  migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDB: migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock,
+}));
+
+vi.mock('uuid', () => ({
+  v4: () => 'pdf-test-id',
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/PdfViewer', () => ({
+  PdfViewer: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="pdf-viewer" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CanvasTutor', () => ({
+  CanvasTutor: vi.fn(({ children }) => <div data-testid="canvas-tutor">{children}</div>),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/AskYouTutor', () => ({
+  AskYouTutor: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="ask-you-tutor" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Sidebar/LibrarySidebar', () => ({
+  LibrarySidebar: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="library-sidebar" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CreditsRequiredDialog', () => ({
+  CreditsRequiredDialog: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({
+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Header/AppHeader', () => ({
+  AppHeader: vi.fn(({ onFileUpload }) => (
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({
+          target: {
+            files: [new File(['%PDF-1.4'], 'chapter-1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })],
+            value: '',
+          },
+        } as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>)
+      }
+    >
+      Trigger Upload
+    </button>
+  )),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useSlideAnalysis', () => ({
+  useSlideAnalysis: vi.fn(() => ({
+    explainSlide: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useFollowUp', () => ({
+  useFollowUp: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleSendMessage: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleRegenerateFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useNotes', () => ({
+  useNotes: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleAddNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleConvertSpatialNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleMoveNote: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useQuiz', () => ({
+  useQuiz: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleGenerateQuestions: vi.fn(),
+    handleAnswersChange: vi.fn(),
+    handleSubmitAnswers: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useChunkRegenerate', () => ({
+  useChunkRegenerate: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleRegenerateChunk: vi.fn(),
+    regeneratingChunks: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/usePdfLibrary', () => ({
+  usePdfLibrary: vi.fn(() => ({
+    loadPdfFromDb: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeletePdf: vi.fn(),
+    loadSavedPdfs: vi.fn(),
+    savedPdfs: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+
+    usePdfStore.setState({
+      fileUrl: null,
+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,
+      pageNumber: 1,
+      leftWidth: 50,
+    } as any);
+
+    useTutorStore.setState({
+      pagesState: {},
+      mode: 'learn',
+      isGeneratingAskYou: false,
+      isSubmittingAskYou: false,
+      isAutoAnalyzing: false,
+      globalAnalysisStatus: 'idle',
+      globalProgress: { current: 0, total: 0, failedPages: [] },
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+  });
+
+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+};
+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';

+

+  updatePDFTags: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFLastPage: vi.fn(),

+vi.mock('./components/PdfViewer', () => ({
+  PdfViewer: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="pdf-viewer" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CanvasTutor', () => ({
+  CanvasTutor: vi.fn(({ children }) => <div data-testid="canvas-tutor">{children}</div>),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/AskYouTutor', () => ({
+  AskYouTutor: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="ask-you-tutor" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Sidebar/LibrarySidebar', () => ({
+  LibrarySidebar: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="library-sidebar" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CreditsRequiredDialog', () => ({
+  CreditsRequiredDialog: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({
+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Header/AppHeader', () => ({
+  AppHeader: vi.fn(({ onFileUpload }) => (
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({
+          target: {
+            files: [new File(['%PDF-1.4'], 'chapter-1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })],
+            value: '',
+          },
+        } as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>)
+      }
+    >
+      Trigger Upload
+    </button>
+  )),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useSlideAnalysis', () => ({
+  useSlideAnalysis: vi.fn(() => ({
+    explainSlide: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useFollowUp', () => ({
+  useFollowUp: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleSendMessage: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleRegenerateFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useNotes', () => ({
+  useNotes: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleAddNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleConvertSpatialNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleMoveNote: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useQuiz', () => ({
+  useQuiz: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleGenerateQuestions: vi.fn(),
+    handleAnswersChange: vi.fn(),
+    handleSubmitAnswers: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useChunkRegenerate', () => ({
+  useChunkRegenerate: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleRegenerateChunk: vi.fn(),
+    regeneratingChunks: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/usePdfLibrary', () => ({
+  usePdfLibrary: vi.fn(() => ({
+    loadPdfFromDb: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeletePdf: vi.fn(),
+    loadSavedPdfs: vi.fn(),
+    savedPdfs: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+
+    usePdfStore.setState({
+      fileUrl: null,
+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,
+      pageNumber: 1,
+      leftWidth: 50,
+    } as any);
+
+    useTutorStore.setState({
+      pagesState: {},
+      mode: 'learn',
+      isGeneratingAskYou: false,
+      isSubmittingAskYou: false,
+      isAutoAnalyzing: false,
+      globalAnalysisStatus: 'idle',
+      globalProgress: { current: 0, total: 0, failedPages: [] },
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+  });
+
+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import App from './App';
+import { usePdfStore } from './store/pdfStore';
+import { useTutorStore } from './store/tutorStore';
+import { useUiStore } from './store/uiStore';
+
+const savePDFMock = vi.fn();
+const migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock = vi.fn();
+
+vi.mock('./lib/db', () => ({
+  savePDF: savePDFMock,
+  updatePDFState: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFTags: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFLastPage: vi.fn(),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./lib/migrate', () => ({
+  migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDB: migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock,
+}));
+
+vi.mock('uuid', () => ({
+  v4: () => 'pdf-test-id',
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/PdfViewer', () => ({
+  PdfViewer: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="pdf-viewer" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CanvasTutor', () => ({
+  CanvasTutor: vi.fn(({ children }) => <div data-testid="canvas-tutor">{children}</div>),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/AskYouTutor', () => ({
+  AskYouTutor: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="ask-you-tutor" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Sidebar/LibrarySidebar', () => ({
+  LibrarySidebar: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="library-sidebar" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CreditsRequiredDialog', () => ({
+  CreditsRequiredDialog: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({
+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Header/AppHeader', () => ({
+  AppHeader: vi.fn(({ onFileUpload }) => (
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({
+          target: {
+            files: [new File(['%PDF-1.4'], 'chapter-1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })],
+            value: '',
+          },
+        } as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>)
+      }
+    >
+      Trigger Upload
+    </button>
+  )),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useSlideAnalysis', () => ({
+  useSlideAnalysis: vi.fn(() => ({
+    explainSlide: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useFollowUp', () => ({
+  useFollowUp: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleSendMessage: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleRegenerateFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useNotes', () => ({
+  useNotes: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleAddNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleConvertSpatialNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleMoveNote: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useQuiz', () => ({
+  useQuiz: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleGenerateQuestions: vi.fn(),
+    handleAnswersChange: vi.fn(),
+    handleSubmitAnswers: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useChunkRegenerate', () => ({
+  useChunkRegenerate: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleRegenerateChunk: vi.fn(),
+    regeneratingChunks: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/usePdfLibrary', () => ({
+  usePdfLibrary: vi.fn(() => ({
+    loadPdfFromDb: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeletePdf: vi.fn(),
+    loadSavedPdfs: vi.fn(),
+    savedPdfs: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+
+    usePdfStore.setState({
+      fileUrl: null,
+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,
+      pageNumber: 1,
+      leftWidth: 50,
+    } as any);
+
+    useTutorStore.setState({
+      pagesState: {},
+      mode: 'learn',
+      isGeneratingAskYou: false,
+      isSubmittingAskYou: false,
+      isAutoAnalyzing: false,
+      globalAnalysisStatus: 'idle',
+      globalProgress: { current: 0, total: 0, failedPages: [] },
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+  });
+
+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';

+vi.mock('./components/PdfViewer', () => ({
+  PdfViewer: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="pdf-viewer" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CanvasTutor', () => ({
+  CanvasTutor: vi.fn(({ children }) => <div data-testid="canvas-tutor">{children}</div>),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/AskYouTutor', () => ({
+  AskYouTutor: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="ask-you-tutor" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Sidebar/LibrarySidebar', () => ({
+  LibrarySidebar: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="library-sidebar" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CreditsRequiredDialog', () => ({
+  CreditsRequiredDialog: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({
+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Header/AppHeader', () => ({
+  AppHeader: vi.fn(({ onFileUpload }) => (
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({
+          target: {
+            files: [new File(['%PDF-1.4'], 'chapter-1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })],
+            value: '',
+          },
+        } as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>)
+      }
+    >
+      Trigger Upload
+    </button>
+  )),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useSlideAnalysis', () => ({
+  useSlideAnalysis: vi.fn(() => ({
+    explainSlide: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useFollowUp', () => ({
+  useFollowUp: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleSendMessage: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleRegenerateFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useNotes', () => ({
+  useNotes: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleAddNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleConvertSpatialNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleMoveNote: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useQuiz', () => ({
+  useQuiz: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleGenerateQuestions: vi.fn(),
+    handleAnswersChange: vi.fn(),
+    handleSubmitAnswers: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useChunkRegenerate', () => ({
+  useChunkRegenerate: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleRegenerateChunk: vi.fn(),
+    regeneratingChunks: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/usePdfLibrary', () => ({
+  usePdfLibrary: vi.fn(() => ({
+    loadPdfFromDb: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeletePdf: vi.fn(),
+    loadSavedPdfs: vi.fn(),
+    savedPdfs: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+
+    usePdfStore.setState({
+      fileUrl: null,
+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,
+      pageNumber: 1,
+      leftWidth: 50,
+    } as any);
+
+    useTutorStore.setState({
+      pagesState: {},
+      mode: 'learn',
+      isGeneratingAskYou: false,
+      isSubmittingAskYou: false,
+      isAutoAnalyzing: false,
+      globalAnalysisStatus: 'idle',
+      globalProgress: { current: 0, total: 0, failedPages: [] },
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+  });
+
+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();

+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));

+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+export const SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES = ['en', 'zh-CN'] as const;
+
+export type ApplicationLanguage = (typeof SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES)[number];
+
+export const APPLICATION_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS: Array<{
+  value: ApplicationLanguage;
+  label: string;
+}> = [
+  { value: 'en', label: 'English' },
+  { value: 'zh-CN', label: '简体中文' },
+];
+
+export const OUTPUT_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS = [
+  { value: 'English', label: 'English' },
+  { value: 'Chinese', label: '中文 (Chinese)' },
+  { value: 'Spanish', label: 'Español (Spanish)' },
+  { value: 'French', label: 'Français (French)' },
+  { value: 'Japanese', label: '日本語 (Japanese)' },
+  { value: 'Korean', label: '한국어 (Korean)' },
+] as const;
+
+type UIText = {

+      platformUnavailable: string;
+      platformLoading: string;
+      hostedCreditsLoadFailed: string;
+      selectModel: string;

+      myApiCredentialsHelp: string;
+      geminiApiKey: string;
+      endpointPreset: string;
+      qwenPreset: string;
+      doubaoPreset: string;
+      customOpenAiCompatible: string;
+      openAiCompatibleApiKey: string;
+      baseUrl: string;
+      modelId: string;
+      optionalParser: string;
+      optionalParserHelp: string;
+      parserProvider: string;
+      noParserDegraded: string;
+      llamaParseApiKey: string;
+      checkingCompatibility: string;
+      modelReady: string;
+      modelUnusable: string;
+      compatibilityPending: string;
+      compatibilityStale: string;
+      outputLanguage: string;
+      outputLanguageHelp: string;
+      accountNotSignedIn: string;
+      signIn: string;
+      signOut: string;
+      buyCredits: string;
+      creditsBalance: string;
+      platformAccount: string;
+      platformCreditsUsage: string;
+      signInRequiredForPlatform: string;
+      usageBreakdown: {
+        analyze: string;
+        followUp: string;
+        cardRegenerate: string;
+        quizGeneration: string;
+        answerAnalysis: string;
+        creditsSingular: string;
+        creditsPlural: string;
+      };
+    };
+    appearance: {
+      sectionTitle: string;
+      applicationLanguage: string;
+      applicationLanguageHelp: string;
+      themeMode: string;
+      themeModeHelp: string;
+    };
+    about: {
+      sectionTitle: string;
+      intro: string;
+      coreFeaturesTitle: string;
+      coreFeatures: string[];
+      basicUsageTitle: string;
+      basicUsage: string[];
+      joinUsTitle: string;
+      joinUsBody: string;
+    };
+    feedback: {
+      sectionTitle: string;
+      successTitle: string;
+      successMessage: string;
+      typeLabel: string;
+      suggestion: string;
+      bug: string;
+      detailLabel: string;

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+        submitting: '提交中...',
+        errors: {
+          uploadLimit: '最多只能上传 3 张图片。',
+          unsupportedImageType: '仅支持 JPG、PNG 和 GIF 格式。',
+          imageTooLarge: '每张图片必须小于 5MB。',
+          typeRequired: '请选择反馈类型。',
+          reasonRequired: '请填写你的建议，或描述你遇到的问题。',
+          emailRequired: '请输入邮箱地址。',
+          emailInvalid: '请输入有效的邮箱地址。',
+        },
+        screenshotAlt: (index) => `截图 ${index}`,
+      },
+    },
+    appHeader: {
+      toggleLibrary: '切换资料库',
+      uploadPdf: '上传 PDF',
+      changePdf: '更换 PDF',
+      feedback: '反馈',
+      settings: '设置',
+    },
+    uploadFlow: {
+      dropTitle: '拖拽 PDF 以上传',
+      dropDescription: '松开鼠标以上传演示文稿',
+      confirmTitle: '确认上传',
+      confirmDescription: (fileName) =>
+        `是否上传 “${fileName}”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。`,
+      cancel: '取消',
+      uploadNow: '立即上传',
+      invalidFileAlert: '请上传 PDF 文件。',
+      uploadFailedAlert: '上传 PDF 失败。请检查浏览器存储空间是否已满。',
+    },
+  },
+};
+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';

+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',

+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();

+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+export const SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES = ['en', 'zh-CN'] as const;
+
+export type ApplicationLanguage = (typeof SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES)[number];
+
+export const APPLICATION_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS: Array<{

+  label: string;

+  { value: 'zh-CN', label: '简体中文' },
+];
+
+export const OUTPUT_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS = [
+  { value: 'English', label: 'English' },
+  { value: 'Chinese', label: '中文 (Chinese)' },
+  { value: 'Spanish', label: 'Español (Spanish)' },
+  { value: 'French', label: 'Français (French)' },
+  { value: 'Japanese', label: '日本語 (Japanese)' },
+  { value: 'Korean', label: '한국어 (Korean)' },

+
+type UIText = {

+      platformUnavailable: string;
+      platformLoading: string;

+      myApiCredentialsHelp: string;
+      geminiApiKey: string;

+      openAiCompatibleApiKey: string;

+      modelId: string;
+      optionalParser: string;
+      optionalParserHelp: string;
+      parserProvider: string;
+      noParserDegraded: string;
+      llamaParseApiKey: string;
+      checkingCompatibility: string;
+      modelReady: string;
+      modelUnusable: string;
+      compatibilityPending: string;
+      compatibilityStale: string;
+      outputLanguage: string;
+      outputLanguageHelp: string;
+      accountNotSignedIn: string;
+      signIn: string;
+      signOut: string;
+      buyCredits: string;
+      creditsBalance: string;
+      platformAccount: string;
+      platformCreditsUsage: string;
+      signInRequiredForPlatform: string;

+        analyze: string;

+        cardRegenerate: string;
+        quizGeneration: string;

+      themeMode: string;
+      themeModeHelp: string;

+      coreFeaturesTitle: string;
+      coreFeatures: string[];

+      basicUsage: string[];

+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+      feedback: '反馈',
+      settings: '设置',
+    },
+    uploadFlow: {
+      dropTitle: '拖拽 PDF 以上传',
+      dropDescription: '松开鼠标以上传演示文稿',
+      confirmTitle: '确认上传',
+      confirmDescription: (fileName) =>
+        `是否上传 “${fileName}”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。`,
+      cancel: '取消',
+      uploadNow: '立即上传',
+      invalidFileAlert: '请上传 PDF 文件。',
+      uploadFailedAlert: '上传 PDF 失败。请检查浏览器存储空间是否已满。',
+    },
+  },
+};
+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

-  const handleImageUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {

-    const newErrors = { ...errors };
-    delete newErrors.images;

-      setErrors(newErrors);
-      return;
-    }

-    const newImages: string[] = [];
-    let hasError = false;
-
-    Array.from(files).forEach(file => {
-      if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif'].includes(file.type)) {
-        newErrors.images = 'Only JPG, PNG, and GIF formats are supported';
-        hasError = true;
-        return;
-      }
-      if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
-        newErrors.images = 'Each image must be smaller than 5MB';
-        hasError = true;
-        return;
-      }
-
-      const reader = new FileReader();
-      reader.onload = (e) => {
-        if (e.target?.result) {
-          setFeedbackImages(prev => [...prev, e.target!.result as string]);
-        }
-      };
-      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
-    });
-
-    if (hasError) {
-      setErrors(newErrors);
-    }
-  };

-        newErrors.email = 'Please enter a valid email address';
-      }
-    }
-    setErrors(newErrors);
-    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';

+
+const savePDFMock = vi.fn();

+

+}));

+vi.mock('./lib/migrate', () => ({
+  migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDB: migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock,
+}));
+
+vi.mock('uuid', () => ({
+  v4: () => 'pdf-test-id',
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/PdfViewer', () => ({
+  PdfViewer: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="pdf-viewer" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CanvasTutor', () => ({
+  CanvasTutor: vi.fn(({ children }) => <div data-testid="canvas-tutor">{children}</div>),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/AskYouTutor', () => ({
+  AskYouTutor: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="ask-you-tutor" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Sidebar/LibrarySidebar', () => ({
+  LibrarySidebar: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="library-sidebar" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CreditsRequiredDialog', () => ({
+  CreditsRequiredDialog: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({
+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Header/AppHeader', () => ({
+  AppHeader: vi.fn(({ onFileUpload }) => (
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({
+          target: {
+            files: [new File(['%PDF-1.4'], 'chapter-1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })],
+            value: '',
+          },
+        } as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>)
+      }
+    >
+      Trigger Upload
+    </button>
+  )),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useSlideAnalysis', () => ({
+  useSlideAnalysis: vi.fn(() => ({
+    explainSlide: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useFollowUp', () => ({

+    handleDeleteNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditNote: vi.fn(),

+    handleAnswersChange: vi.fn(),
+    handleSubmitAnswers: vi.fn(),

+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+
+    usePdfStore.setState({
+      fileUrl: null,
+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,
+      pageNumber: 1,
+      leftWidth: 50,

+
+    useTutorStore.setState({

+      isGeneratingAskYou: false,

+    } as any);
+  });
+
+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {

+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();

+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));

+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {

+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',

+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',

+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+  });
+
+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+          typeRequired: '请选择反馈类型。',
+          reasonRequired: '请填写你的建议，或描述你遇到的问题。',
+          emailRequired: '请输入邮箱地址。',
+          emailInvalid: '请输入有效的邮箱地址。',
+        },
+        screenshotAlt: (index) => `截图 ${index}`,
+      },
+    },
+    appHeader: {
+      toggleLibrary: '切换资料库',
+      uploadPdf: '上传 PDF',
+      changePdf: '更换 PDF',
+      feedback: '反馈',
+      settings: '设置',
+    },
+    uploadFlow: {
+      dropTitle: '拖拽 PDF 以上传',
+      dropDescription: '松开鼠标以上传演示文稿',
+      confirmTitle: '确认上传',
+      confirmDescription: (fileName) =>
+        `是否上传 “${fileName}”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。`,
+      cancel: '取消',
+      uploadNow: '立即上传',
+      invalidFileAlert: '请上传 PDF 文件。',
+      uploadFailedAlert: '上传 PDF 失败。请检查浏览器存储空间是否已满。',
+    },
+  },
+};
+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import App from './App';
+import { usePdfStore } from './store/pdfStore';
+import { useTutorStore } from './store/tutorStore';
+import { useUiStore } from './store/uiStore';
+
+const savePDFMock = vi.fn();
+const migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock = vi.fn();
+
+vi.mock('./lib/db', () => ({
+  savePDF: savePDFMock,
+  updatePDFState: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFTags: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFLastPage: vi.fn(),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./lib/migrate', () => ({
+  migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDB: migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock,
+}));
+
+vi.mock('uuid', () => ({
+  v4: () => 'pdf-test-id',
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/PdfViewer', () => ({
+  PdfViewer: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="pdf-viewer" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CanvasTutor', () => ({
+  CanvasTutor: vi.fn(({ children }) => <div data-testid="canvas-tutor">{children}</div>),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/AskYouTutor', () => ({
+  AskYouTutor: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="ask-you-tutor" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Sidebar/LibrarySidebar', () => ({
+  LibrarySidebar: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="library-sidebar" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CreditsRequiredDialog', () => ({
+  CreditsRequiredDialog: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({
+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Header/AppHeader', () => ({
+  AppHeader: vi.fn(({ onFileUpload }) => (
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({
+          target: {
+            files: [new File(['%PDF-1.4'], 'chapter-1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })],
+            value: '',
+          },
+        } as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>)
+      }
+    >
+      Trigger Upload
+    </button>
+  )),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useSlideAnalysis', () => ({
+  useSlideAnalysis: vi.fn(() => ({
+    explainSlide: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useFollowUp', () => ({
+  useFollowUp: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleSendMessage: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleRegenerateFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useNotes', () => ({
+  useNotes: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleAddNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleConvertSpatialNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleMoveNote: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useQuiz', () => ({
+  useQuiz: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleGenerateQuestions: vi.fn(),
+    handleAnswersChange: vi.fn(),
+    handleSubmitAnswers: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useChunkRegenerate', () => ({
+  useChunkRegenerate: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleRegenerateChunk: vi.fn(),
+    regeneratingChunks: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/usePdfLibrary', () => ({
+  usePdfLibrary: vi.fn(() => ({
+    loadPdfFromDb: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeletePdf: vi.fn(),
+    loadSavedPdfs: vi.fn(),
+    savedPdfs: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+
+    usePdfStore.setState({
+      fileUrl: null,
+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,
+      pageNumber: 1,
+      leftWidth: 50,
+    } as any);
+
+    useTutorStore.setState({
+      pagesState: {},
+      mode: 'learn',
+      isGeneratingAskYou: false,
+      isSubmittingAskYou: false,
+      isAutoAnalyzing: false,
+      globalAnalysisStatus: 'idle',
+      globalProgress: { current: 0, total: 0, failedPages: [] },
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+  });
+
+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+export const SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES = ['en', 'zh-CN'] as const;
+
+export type ApplicationLanguage = (typeof SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES)[number];
+
+export const APPLICATION_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS: Array<{
+  value: ApplicationLanguage;
+  label: string;
+}> = [
+  { value: 'en', label: 'English' },
+  { value: 'zh-CN', label: '简体中文' },
+];
+
+export const OUTPUT_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS = [
+  { value: 'English', label: 'English' },
+  { value: 'Chinese', label: '中文 (Chinese)' },
+  { value: 'Spanish', label: 'Español (Spanish)' },
+  { value: 'French', label: 'Français (French)' },
+  { value: 'Japanese', label: '日本語 (Japanese)' },
+  { value: 'Korean', label: '한국어 (Korean)' },
+] as const;
+
+type UIText = {
+  settingsModal: {
+    modalTitle: string;
+    tabs: {
+      ai: string;
+      appearance: string;
+      about: string;
+      feedback: string;
+    };
+    ai: {
+      sectionTitle: string;
+      accessMode: string;
+      accessModeInfoPrimary: string;
+      accessModeInfoSecondary: string;
+      myApi: string;
+      myApiHelp: string;
+      platformApi: string;
+      platformApiHelp: string;
+      platformUnavailable: string;
+      platformLoading: string;
+      hostedCreditsLoadFailed: string;
+      selectModel: string;
+      myApiCredentials: string;
+      myApiCredentialsHelp: string;
+      geminiApiKey: string;
+      endpointPreset: string;
+      qwenPreset: string;
+      doubaoPreset: string;

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+        upload: '上传',
+        contactAgreement: '是否同意我们通过邮箱就这条反馈继续联系你？',
+        emailLabel: '邮箱地址',
+        emailPlaceholder: '请输入你的邮箱地址',
+        cancel: '取消',
+        submit: '提交',
+        submitting: '提交中...',
+        errors: {
+          uploadLimit: '最多只能上传 3 张图片。',
+          unsupportedImageType: '仅支持 JPG、PNG 和 GIF 格式。',
+          imageTooLarge: '每张图片必须小于 5MB。',
+          typeRequired: '请选择反馈类型。',
+          reasonRequired: '请填写你的建议，或描述你遇到的问题。',
+          emailRequired: '请输入邮箱地址。',
+          emailInvalid: '请输入有效的邮箱地址。',
+        },
+        screenshotAlt: (index) => `截图 ${index}`,
+      },
+    },
+    appHeader: {
+      toggleLibrary: '切换资料库',
+      uploadPdf: '上传 PDF',
+      changePdf: '更换 PDF',
+      feedback: '反馈',
+      settings: '设置',
+    },
+    uploadFlow: {
+      dropTitle: '拖拽 PDF 以上传',
+      dropDescription: '松开鼠标以上传演示文稿',
+      confirmTitle: '确认上传',
+      confirmDescription: (fileName) =>
+        `是否上传 “${fileName}”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。`,
+      cancel: '取消',
+      uploadNow: '立即上传',
+      invalidFileAlert: '请上传 PDF 文件。',
+      uploadFailedAlert: '上传 PDF 失败。请检查浏览器存储空间是否已满。',
+    },
+  },
+};
+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import App from './App';
+import { usePdfStore } from './store/pdfStore';
+import { useTutorStore } from './store/tutorStore';
+import { useUiStore } from './store/uiStore';
+
+const savePDFMock = vi.fn();
+const migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock = vi.fn();
+
+vi.mock('./lib/db', () => ({
+  savePDF: savePDFMock,
+  updatePDFState: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFTags: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFLastPage: vi.fn(),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./lib/migrate', () => ({
+  migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDB: migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock,
+}));
+
+vi.mock('uuid', () => ({
+  v4: () => 'pdf-test-id',
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/PdfViewer', () => ({
+  PdfViewer: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="pdf-viewer" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CanvasTutor', () => ({
+  CanvasTutor: vi.fn(({ children }) => <div data-testid="canvas-tutor">{children}</div>),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/AskYouTutor', () => ({
+  AskYouTutor: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="ask-you-tutor" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Sidebar/LibrarySidebar', () => ({
+  LibrarySidebar: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="library-sidebar" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CreditsRequiredDialog', () => ({
+  CreditsRequiredDialog: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({
+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Header/AppHeader', () => ({
+  AppHeader: vi.fn(({ onFileUpload }) => (
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({
+          target: {
+            files: [new File(['%PDF-1.4'], 'chapter-1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })],
+            value: '',
+          },
+        } as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>)
+      }
+    >
+      Trigger Upload
+    </button>
+  )),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useSlideAnalysis', () => ({
+  useSlideAnalysis: vi.fn(() => ({
+    explainSlide: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useFollowUp', () => ({
+  useFollowUp: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleSendMessage: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleRegenerateFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useNotes', () => ({
+  useNotes: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleAddNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleConvertSpatialNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleMoveNote: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useQuiz', () => ({
+  useQuiz: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleGenerateQuestions: vi.fn(),
+    handleAnswersChange: vi.fn(),
+    handleSubmitAnswers: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useChunkRegenerate', () => ({
+  useChunkRegenerate: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleRegenerateChunk: vi.fn(),
+    regeneratingChunks: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/usePdfLibrary', () => ({
+  usePdfLibrary: vi.fn(() => ({
+    loadPdfFromDb: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeletePdf: vi.fn(),
+    loadSavedPdfs: vi.fn(),
+    savedPdfs: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+
+    usePdfStore.setState({
+      fileUrl: null,
+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,
+      pageNumber: 1,
+      leftWidth: 50,
+    } as any);
+
+    useTutorStore.setState({
+      pagesState: {},
+      mode: 'learn',
+      isGeneratingAskYou: false,
+      isSubmittingAskYou: false,
+      isAutoAnalyzing: false,
+      globalAnalysisStatus: 'idle',
+      globalProgress: { current: 0, total: 0, failedPages: [] },
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+  });
+
+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

-  const handleImageUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
-    const files = e.target.files;
-    if (!files) return;
-
-    const newErrors = { ...errors };
-    delete newErrors.images;
-
-    if (feedbackImages.length + files.length > 3) {
-      newErrors.images = 'You can only upload up to 3 images';
-      setErrors(newErrors);
-      return;
-    }
-
-    const newImages: string[] = [];
-    let hasError = false;
-
-    Array.from(files).forEach(file => {
-      if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif'].includes(file.type)) {
-        newErrors.images = 'Only JPG, PNG, and GIF formats are supported';
-        hasError = true;
-        return;
-      }
-      if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
-        newErrors.images = 'Each image must be smaller than 5MB';
-        hasError = true;
-        return;
-      }
-
-      const reader = new FileReader();
-      reader.onload = (e) => {
-        if (e.target?.result) {
-          setFeedbackImages(prev => [...prev, e.target!.result as string]);
-        }
-      };
-      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
-    });
-
-    if (hasError) {
-      setErrors(newErrors);
-    }
-  };
-
-  const removeImage = (index: number) => {
-    setFeedbackImages(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
-  };

-  const validateFeedback = () => {
-    const newErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
-    if (!feedbackType) newErrors.type = 'Please select a feedback type';
-    if (!feedbackReason.trim()) newErrors.reason = 'Please describe your suggestion or the bug you encountered';
-    if (contactAgreed) {
-      if (!userEmail.trim()) {
-        newErrors.email = 'Please enter your email address';
-      } else if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(userEmail)) {
-        newErrors.email = 'Please enter a valid email address';
-      }
-    }
-    setErrors(newErrors);
-    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
-  };
-
-  const submitFeedback = async () => {
-    if (!validateFeedback()) return;
-
-    setIsSubmitting(true);
-    setSubmitStatus('idle');
-    setSubmitErrorMessage('Failed to submit feedback. Please try again later.');
-
-    try {
-      const response = await fetch('/api/feedback', {
-        method: 'POST',
-        headers: {
-          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
-        },
-        body: JSON.stringify({
-          type: feedbackType === 'suggestion' ? 'Suggestion' : 'Bug',
-          reason: feedbackReason,
-          images: feedbackImages,
-          contactAgreed,
-          email: userEmail,
-        }),
-      });
-
-      if (!response.ok) {
-        const errorData = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
-        throw new Error(errorData.error || 'Submission failed');
-      }
-
-      setSubmitStatus('success');
-      setTimeout(() => {
-        onClose();
-        // Reset form
-        setFeedbackType(null);
-        setFeedbackReason('');
-        setFeedbackImages([]);
-        setContactAgreed(false);
-        setUserEmail('');
-        setSubmitStatus('idle');
-      }, 2000);
-    } catch (error) {
-      console.error('Feedback error:', error);
-      setSubmitErrorMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to submit feedback. Please try again later.');
-      setSubmitStatus('error');

+export const SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES = ['en', 'zh-CN'] as const;

+
+export const OUTPUT_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS = [

+  { value: 'French', label: 'Français (French)' },

+

+      platformApiHelp: string;
+      platformUnavailable: string;
+      platformLoading: string;

+      selectModel: string;

+      optionalParserHelp: string;
+      parserProvider: string;

+      llamaParseApiKey: string;
