+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import App from './App';
+import { usePdfStore } from './store/pdfStore';
+import { useTutorStore } from './store/tutorStore';
+import { useUiStore } from './store/uiStore';
+
+const savePDFMock = vi.fn();
+const migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock = vi.fn();
+
+vi.mock('./lib/db', () => ({
+  savePDF: savePDFMock,
+  updatePDFState: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFTags: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFLastPage: vi.fn(),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./lib/migrate', () => ({
+  migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDB: migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock,
+}));
+
+vi.mock('uuid', () => ({
+  v4: () => 'pdf-test-id',
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/PdfViewer', () => ({
+  PdfViewer: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="pdf-viewer" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CanvasTutor', () => ({
+  CanvasTutor: vi.fn(({ children }) => <div data-testid="canvas-tutor">{children}</div>),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/AskYouTutor', () => ({
+  AskYouTutor: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="ask-you-tutor" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Sidebar/LibrarySidebar', () => ({
+  LibrarySidebar: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="library-sidebar" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CreditsRequiredDialog', () => ({
+  CreditsRequiredDialog: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({
+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Header/AppHeader', () => ({
+  AppHeader: vi.fn(({ onFileUpload }) => (
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({
+          target: {
+            files: [new File(['%PDF-1.4'], 'chapter-1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })],
+            value: '',
+          },
+        } as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>)
+      }
+    >
+      Trigger Upload
+    </button>
+  )),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useSlideAnalysis', () => ({
+  useSlideAnalysis: vi.fn(() => ({
+    explainSlide: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useFollowUp', () => ({
+  useFollowUp: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleSendMessage: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleRegenerateFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useNotes', () => ({
+  useNotes: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleAddNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleConvertSpatialNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleMoveNote: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useQuiz', () => ({
+  useQuiz: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleGenerateQuestions: vi.fn(),
+    handleAnswersChange: vi.fn(),
+    handleSubmitAnswers: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useChunkRegenerate', () => ({
+  useChunkRegenerate: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleRegenerateChunk: vi.fn(),
+    regeneratingChunks: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/usePdfLibrary', () => ({
+  usePdfLibrary: vi.fn(() => ({
+    loadPdfFromDb: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeletePdf: vi.fn(),
+    loadSavedPdfs: vi.fn(),
+    savedPdfs: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+
+    usePdfStore.setState({
+      fileUrl: null,
+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,
+      pageNumber: 1,
+      leftWidth: 50,
+    } as any);
+
+    useTutorStore.setState({
+      pagesState: {},
+      mode: 'learn',
+      isGeneratingAskYou: false,
+      isSubmittingAskYou: false,
+      isAutoAnalyzing: false,
+      globalAnalysisStatus: 'idle',
+      globalProgress: { current: 0, total: 0, failedPages: [] },
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+  });
+
+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
+import { AlertCircle, CheckCircle2, Cpu, Info, Loader2, MessageSquare, Palette, Upload, X } from 'lucide-react';
+
+import { MODEL_CONFIG, type OpenAiCompatibleEndpointPreset, type ProviderId, type SelectedModel, getOpenAiCompatibleBaseURL } from '../config/models';
+import { checkModelCapability } from '../lib/api/apiClient';
+import { APPLICATION_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS, OUTPUT_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS, getUIText } from '../lib/i18n';
+import { useUiStore } from '../store/uiStore';
+import { BuyCreditsDialog } from './settings/BuyCreditsDialog';
+import { PlatformApiSection } from './settings/PlatformApiSection';
+import { ThemeToggle } from './ThemeToggle';
+import { InfoTrigger } from './ui/InfoTrigger';
+
+interface SettingsModalProps {
+  isOpen: boolean;
+  onClose: () => void;
+  selectedModel: SelectedModel;
+  setSelectedModel: (model: SelectedModel) => void;
+  outputLanguage: string;
+  setOutputLanguage: (lang: string) => void;
+  isBuyCreditsDialogOpen?: boolean;
+  onOpenBuyCredits?: () => void;
+  onCloseBuyCredits?: () => void;
+}
+
+export const SettingsModal: React.FC<SettingsModalProps> = ({
+  isOpen,
+  onClose,
+  selectedModel,
+  setSelectedModel,
+  outputLanguage,
+  setOutputLanguage,
+  isBuyCreditsDialogOpen,
+  onOpenBuyCredits,
+  onCloseBuyCredits,
+}) => {
+  const activeTab = useUiStore((state) => state.settingsTab);
+  const setActiveTab = useUiStore((state) => state.setSettingsTab);
+  const aiAccess = useUiStore((state) => state.aiAccess);
+  const accessMode = useUiStore((state) => state.accessMode);
+  const applicationLanguage = useUiStore((state) => state.applicationLanguage);
+  const setApplicationLanguage = useUiStore((state) => state.setApplicationLanguage);
+  const modelCapabilityCheck = useUiStore((state) => state.modelCapabilityCheck);
+  const setAiAccess = useUiStore((state) => state.setAiAccess);
+  const setModelCapabilityCheck = useUiStore((state) => state.setModelCapabilityCheck);
+
+  const [feedbackType, setFeedbackType] = useState<'suggestion' | 'bug' | null>(null);
+  const [feedbackReason, setFeedbackReason] = useState('');
+  const [feedbackImages, setFeedbackImages] = useState<string[]>([]);
+  const [contactAgreed, setContactAgreed] = useState(false);
+  const [userEmail, setUserEmail] = useState('');
+  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
+  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
+  const [submitStatus, setSubmitStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'success' | 'error'>('idle');
+  const [submitErrorMessage, setSubmitErrorMessage] = useState('Failed to submit feedback. Please try again later.');
+  const [localBuyCreditsDialogOpen, setLocalBuyCreditsDialogOpen] = useState(false);
+
+  const buyCreditsDialogOpen = isBuyCreditsDialogOpen ?? localBuyCreditsDialogOpen;
+  const openBuyCreditsDialog = onOpenBuyCredits ?? (() => setLocalBuyCreditsDialogOpen(true));
+  const closeBuyCreditsDialog = onCloseBuyCredits ?? (() => setLocalBuyCreditsDialogOpen(false));
+
+  const text = getUIText(applicationLanguage).settingsModal;
+  const aiText = text.ai;
+  const appearanceText = text.appearance;
+  const aboutText = text.about;
+  const feedbackText = text.feedback;
+
+  const selectedEndpointPreset =
+    selectedModel.providerId === 'openai-compatible' ? selectedModel.endpointPreset || 'qwen' : undefined;
+
+  const selectedModelValue =
+    selectedModel.providerId === 'openai-compatible'
+      ? `openai-compatible|${selectedEndpointPreset}|${selectedModel.modelId}`
+      : `gemini|default|${selectedModel.modelId}`;
+
+  const updateOpenAiAccess = (updater: (current: typeof aiAccess.openAiCompatible) => typeof aiAccess.openAiCompatible) => {
+    setAiAccess({ ...aiAccess, openAiCompatible: updater(aiAccess.openAiCompatible) });
+  };
+
+  const updateParserAccess = (updater: (current: typeof aiAccess.parser) => typeof aiAccess.parser) => {
+    setAiAccess({ ...aiAccess, parser: updater(aiAccess.parser) });
+  };
+
+  const handleModelSelectionChange = (rawValue: string) => {
+    const [providerId, endpointPresetValue, modelId] = rawValue.split('|');
+    if (providerId === 'openai-compatible') {
+      const endpointPreset = endpointPresetValue as OpenAiCompatibleEndpointPreset;
+      setSelectedModel({ providerId: 'openai-compatible', endpointPreset, modelId });
+      updateOpenAiAccess((current) => ({
+        ...current,
+        endpointPreset,
+        baseURL: endpointPreset === 'custom' ? current.baseURL : getOpenAiCompatibleBaseURL(endpointPreset),
+      }));
+      return;
+    }
+    setSelectedModel({ providerId: providerId as ProviderId, modelId });
+  };
+
+  const byokConfigReady =
+    accessMode === 'byok' &&
+    (selectedModel.providerId === 'gemini'
+      ? aiAccess.gemini.apiKey.trim().length > 0
+      : aiAccess.openAiCompatible.apiKey.trim().length > 0 && aiAccess.openAiCompatible.baseURL.trim().length > 0);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (!isOpen || accessMode !== 'byok' || !byokConfigReady) return;
+    let cancelled = false;
+    const selection = {
+      providerId: selectedModel.providerId,
+      modelId: selectedModel.modelId,
+      endpointPreset: selectedModel.providerId === 'openai-compatible' ? selectedEndpointPreset : undefined,
+    };
+    setModelCapabilityCheck({ ...modelCapabilityCheck, status: 'checking', selection });
+    const timeoutId = window.setTimeout(() => {
+      checkModelCapability(selection)
+        .then((result) => {
+          if (!cancelled) setModelCapabilityCheck({ ...result, selection });
+        })
+        .catch(() => {
+          if (!cancelled) {
+            setModelCapabilityCheck({
+              status: 'pending',
+              checkedAt: null,
+              lastErrorCode: 'MODEL_CAPABILITY_CHECK_FAILED',
+              capabilitySummary: null,
+              selection,
+            });
+          }
+        });
+    }, 150);
+    return () => {
+      cancelled = true;
+      window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
+    };
+  }, [
+    accessMode,
+    aiAccess.gemini.apiKey,
+    aiAccess.openAiCompatible.apiKey,
+    aiAccess.openAiCompatible.baseURL,
+    byokConfigReady,
+    isOpen,
+    modelCapabilityCheck,
+    selectedEndpointPreset,
+    selectedModel.modelId,
+    selectedModel.providerId,
+    setModelCapabilityCheck,
+  ]);
+
+  const handleImageUpload = (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
+    const files = event.target.files;
+    if (!files) return;
+    const nextErrors = { ...errors };
+    delete nextErrors.images;
+    if (feedbackImages.length + files.length > 3) {
+      nextErrors.images = feedbackText.errors.uploadLimit;
+      setErrors(nextErrors);
+      return;
+    }
+    let hasError = false;
+    Array.from(files).forEach((file) => {
+      if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif'].includes(file.type)) {
+        nextErrors.images = feedbackText.errors.unsupportedImageType;
+        hasError = true;
+        return;
+      }
+      if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
+        nextErrors.images = feedbackText.errors.imageTooLarge;
+        hasError = true;
+        return;
+      }
+      const reader = new FileReader();
+      reader.onload = (readerEvent) => {
+        if (readerEvent.target?.result) {
+          setFeedbackImages((prev) => [...prev, readerEvent.target!.result as string]);
+        }
+      };
+      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
+    });
+    if (hasError) setErrors(nextErrors);
+  };
+
+  const removeImage = (index: number) => {
+    setFeedbackImages((prev) => prev.filter((_, imageIndex) => imageIndex !== index));
+  };
+
+  const validateFeedback = () => {
+    const nextErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
+    if (!feedbackType) nextErrors.type = feedbackText.errors.typeRequired;
+    if (!feedbackReason.trim()) nextErrors.reason = feedbackText.errors.reasonRequired;
+    if (contactAgreed) {
+      if (!userEmail.trim()) nextErrors.email = feedbackText.errors.emailRequired;
+      else if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(userEmail)) nextErrors.email = feedbackText.errors.emailInvalid;
+    }
+    setErrors(nextErrors);
+    return Object.keys(nextErrors).length === 0;
+  };
+
+  const submitFeedback = async () => {
+    if (!validateFeedback()) return;
+    setIsSubmitting(true);
+    setSubmitStatus('idle');
+    setSubmitErrorMessage('Failed to submit feedback. Please try again later.');
+    try {
+      const response = await fetch('/api/feedback', {
+        method: 'POST',
+        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+        body: JSON.stringify({
+          type: feedbackType === 'suggestion' ? 'Suggestion' : 'Bug',
+          reason: feedbackReason,
+          images: feedbackImages,
+          contactAgreed,
+          email: userEmail,
+        }),
+      });
+      if (!response.ok) {
+        const errorData = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
+        throw new Error(errorData.error || 'Submission failed');
+      }
+      setSubmitStatus('success');
+      setTimeout(() => {
+        onClose();
+        setFeedbackType(null);
+        setFeedbackReason('');
+        setFeedbackImages([]);
+        setContactAgreed(false);
+        setUserEmail('');
+        setSubmitStatus('idle');
+      }, 2000);
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.error('Feedback error:', error);
+      setSubmitErrorMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to submit feedback. Please try again later.');
+      setSubmitStatus('error');
+    } finally {
+      setIsSubmitting(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  if (!isOpen) return null;
+
+  return null;
+};

+    appHeader: {
+      toggleLibrary: '切换资料库',

+      changePdf: '更换 PDF',

+    },

+      cancel: '取消',
+      uploadNow: '立即上传',
+      invalidFileAlert: '请上传 PDF 文件。',

+    },

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

new file mode 100644

@@ -0,0 +1,191 @@
+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import App from './App';
+import { usePdfStore } from './store/pdfStore';
+import { useTutorStore } from './store/tutorStore';
+import { useUiStore } from './store/uiStore';
+
+const savePDFMock = vi.fn();
+const migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock = vi.fn();
+
+vi.mock('./lib/db', () => ({
+  savePDF: savePDFMock,
+  updatePDFState: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFTags: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFLastPage: vi.fn(),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./lib/migrate', () => ({
+  migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDB: migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock,
+}));
+
+vi.mock('uuid', () => ({
+  v4: () => 'pdf-test-id',
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/PdfViewer', () => ({
+  PdfViewer: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="pdf-viewer" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CanvasTutor', () => ({
+  CanvasTutor: vi.fn(({ children }) => <div data-testid="canvas-tutor">{children}</div>),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/AskYouTutor', () => ({
+  AskYouTutor: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="ask-you-tutor" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Sidebar/LibrarySidebar', () => ({
+  LibrarySidebar: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="library-sidebar" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CreditsRequiredDialog', () => ({
+  CreditsRequiredDialog: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({
+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Header/AppHeader', () => ({
+  AppHeader: vi.fn(({ onFileUpload }) => (
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({
+          target: {
+            files: [new File(['%PDF-1.4'], 'chapter-1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })],
+            value: '',
+          },
+        } as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>)
+      }
+    >
+      Trigger Upload
+    </button>
+  )),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useSlideAnalysis', () => ({
+  useSlideAnalysis: vi.fn(() => ({
+    explainSlide: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useFollowUp', () => ({
+  useFollowUp: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleSendMessage: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleRegenerateFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useNotes', () => ({
+  useNotes: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleAddNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleConvertSpatialNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleMoveNote: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useQuiz', () => ({
+  useQuiz: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleGenerateQuestions: vi.fn(),
+    handleAnswersChange: vi.fn(),
+    handleSubmitAnswers: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useChunkRegenerate', () => ({
+  useChunkRegenerate: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleRegenerateChunk: vi.fn(),
+    regeneratingChunks: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/usePdfLibrary', () => ({
+  usePdfLibrary: vi.fn(() => ({
+    loadPdfFromDb: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeletePdf: vi.fn(),
+    loadSavedPdfs: vi.fn(),
+    savedPdfs: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+
+    usePdfStore.setState({
+      fileUrl: null,
+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,
+      pageNumber: 1,
+      leftWidth: 50,
+    } as any);
+
+    useTutorStore.setState({
+      pagesState: {},
+      mode: 'learn',
+      isGeneratingAskYou: false,
+      isSubmittingAskYou: false,
+      isAutoAnalyzing: false,
+      globalAnalysisStatus: 'idle',
+      globalProgress: { current: 0, total: 0, failedPages: [] },
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+  });
+
+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

+import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
+import { AlertCircle, CheckCircle2, Cpu, Info, Loader2, MessageSquare, Palette, Upload, X } from 'lucide-react';
+
+import { MODEL_CONFIG, type OpenAiCompatibleEndpointPreset, type ProviderId, type SelectedModel, getOpenAiCompatibleBaseURL } from '../config/models';
+import { checkModelCapability } from '../lib/api/apiClient';
+import { APPLICATION_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS, OUTPUT_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS, getUIText } from '../lib/i18n';
+import { useUiStore } from '../store/uiStore';
+import { BuyCreditsDialog } from './settings/BuyCreditsDialog';
+import { PlatformApiSection } from './settings/PlatformApiSection';
+import { ThemeToggle } from './ThemeToggle';
+import { InfoTrigger } from './ui/InfoTrigger';
+
+interface SettingsModalProps {
+  isOpen: boolean;
+  onClose: () => void;
+  selectedModel: SelectedModel;
+  setSelectedModel: (model: SelectedModel) => void;
+  outputLanguage: string;
+  setOutputLanguage: (lang: string) => void;
+  isBuyCreditsDialogOpen?: boolean;
+  onOpenBuyCredits?: () => void;
+  onCloseBuyCredits?: () => void;
+}
+
+export const SettingsModal: React.FC<SettingsModalProps> = ({
+  isOpen,
+  onClose,
+  selectedModel,
+  setSelectedModel,
+  outputLanguage,
+  setOutputLanguage,
+  isBuyCreditsDialogOpen,
+  onOpenBuyCredits,
+  onCloseBuyCredits,
+}) => {
+  const activeTab = useUiStore((state) => state.settingsTab);
+  const setActiveTab = useUiStore((state) => state.setSettingsTab);
+  const aiAccess = useUiStore((state) => state.aiAccess);
+  const accessMode = useUiStore((state) => state.accessMode);
+  const applicationLanguage = useUiStore((state) => state.applicationLanguage);
+  const setApplicationLanguage = useUiStore((state) => state.setApplicationLanguage);
+  const modelCapabilityCheck = useUiStore((state) => state.modelCapabilityCheck);
+  const setAiAccess = useUiStore((state) => state.setAiAccess);
+  const setModelCapabilityCheck = useUiStore((state) => state.setModelCapabilityCheck);
+
+  const [feedbackType, setFeedbackType] = useState<'suggestion' | 'bug' | null>(null);
+  const [feedbackReason, setFeedbackReason] = useState('');
+  const [feedbackImages, setFeedbackImages] = useState<string[]>([]);
+  const [contactAgreed, setContactAgreed] = useState(false);
+  const [userEmail, setUserEmail] = useState('');
+  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
+  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
+  const [submitStatus, setSubmitStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'success' | 'error'>('idle');
+  const [submitErrorMessage, setSubmitErrorMessage] = useState('Failed to submit feedback. Please try again later.');
+  const [localBuyCreditsDialogOpen, setLocalBuyCreditsDialogOpen] = useState(false);
+
+  const buyCreditsDialogOpen = isBuyCreditsDialogOpen ?? localBuyCreditsDialogOpen;
+  const openBuyCreditsDialog = onOpenBuyCredits ?? (() => setLocalBuyCreditsDialogOpen(true));
+  const closeBuyCreditsDialog = onCloseBuyCredits ?? (() => setLocalBuyCreditsDialogOpen(false));
+
+  const text = getUIText(applicationLanguage).settingsModal;
+  const aiText = text.ai;
+  const appearanceText = text.appearance;
+  const aboutText = text.about;
+  const feedbackText = text.feedback;
+
+  const selectedEndpointPreset =
+    selectedModel.providerId === 'openai-compatible' ? selectedModel.endpointPreset || 'qwen' : undefined;
+
+  const selectedModelValue =
+    selectedModel.providerId === 'openai-compatible'
+      ? `openai-compatible|${selectedEndpointPreset}|${selectedModel.modelId}`
+      : `gemini|default|${selectedModel.modelId}`;
+
+  const updateOpenAiAccess = (updater: (current: typeof aiAccess.openAiCompatible) => typeof aiAccess.openAiCompatible) => {
+    setAiAccess({ ...aiAccess, openAiCompatible: updater(aiAccess.openAiCompatible) });
+  };
+
+  const updateParserAccess = (updater: (current: typeof aiAccess.parser) => typeof aiAccess.parser) => {
+    setAiAccess({ ...aiAccess, parser: updater(aiAccess.parser) });
+  };
+
+  const handleModelSelectionChange = (rawValue: string) => {
+    const [providerId, endpointPresetValue, modelId] = rawValue.split('|');
+    if (providerId === 'openai-compatible') {
+      const endpointPreset = endpointPresetValue as OpenAiCompatibleEndpointPreset;
+      setSelectedModel({ providerId: 'openai-compatible', endpointPreset, modelId });
+      updateOpenAiAccess((current) => ({
+        ...current,
+        endpointPreset,
+        baseURL: endpointPreset === 'custom' ? current.baseURL : getOpenAiCompatibleBaseURL(endpointPreset),
+      }));
+      return;
+    }
+    setSelectedModel({ providerId: providerId as ProviderId, modelId });
+  };
+
+  const byokConfigReady =
+    accessMode === 'byok' &&
+    (selectedModel.providerId === 'gemini'
+      ? aiAccess.gemini.apiKey.trim().length > 0
+      : aiAccess.openAiCompatible.apiKey.trim().length > 0 && aiAccess.openAiCompatible.baseURL.trim().length > 0);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (!isOpen || accessMode !== 'byok' || !byokConfigReady) return;
+    let cancelled = false;
+    const selection = {
+      providerId: selectedModel.providerId,
+      modelId: selectedModel.modelId,
+      endpointPreset: selectedModel.providerId === 'openai-compatible' ? selectedEndpointPreset : undefined,
+    };
+    setModelCapabilityCheck({ ...modelCapabilityCheck, status: 'checking', selection });
+    const timeoutId = window.setTimeout(() => {
+      checkModelCapability(selection)
+        .then((result) => {
+          if (!cancelled) setModelCapabilityCheck({ ...result, selection });
+        })
+        .catch(() => {
+          if (!cancelled) {
+            setModelCapabilityCheck({
+              status: 'pending',
+              checkedAt: null,
+              lastErrorCode: 'MODEL_CAPABILITY_CHECK_FAILED',
+              capabilitySummary: null,
+              selection,
+            });
+          }
+        });
+    }, 150);
+    return () => {
+      cancelled = true;
+      window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
+    };
+  }, [
+    accessMode,
+    aiAccess.gemini.apiKey,
+    aiAccess.openAiCompatible.apiKey,
+    aiAccess.openAiCompatible.baseURL,
+    byokConfigReady,
+    isOpen,
+    modelCapabilityCheck,
+    selectedEndpointPreset,
+    selectedModel.modelId,
+    selectedModel.providerId,
+    setModelCapabilityCheck,
+  ]);
+
+  const handleImageUpload = (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
+    const files = event.target.files;
+    if (!files) return;
+    const nextErrors = { ...errors };
+    delete nextErrors.images;
+    if (feedbackImages.length + files.length > 3) {
+      nextErrors.images = feedbackText.errors.uploadLimit;
+      setErrors(nextErrors);
+      return;
+    }
+    let hasError = false;
+    Array.from(files).forEach((file) => {
+      if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif'].includes(file.type)) {
+        nextErrors.images = feedbackText.errors.unsupportedImageType;
+        hasError = true;
+        return;
+      }
+      if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
+        nextErrors.images = feedbackText.errors.imageTooLarge;
+        hasError = true;
+        return;
+      }
+      const reader = new FileReader();
+      reader.onload = (readerEvent) => {
+        if (readerEvent.target?.result) {
+          setFeedbackImages((prev) => [...prev, readerEvent.target!.result as string]);
+        }
+      };
+      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
+    });
+    if (hasError) setErrors(nextErrors);
+  };
+
+  const removeImage = (index: number) => {
+    setFeedbackImages((prev) => prev.filter((_, imageIndex) => imageIndex !== index));
+  };
+
+  const validateFeedback = () => {
+    const nextErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
+    if (!feedbackType) nextErrors.type = feedbackText.errors.typeRequired;
+    if (!feedbackReason.trim()) nextErrors.reason = feedbackText.errors.reasonRequired;
+    if (contactAgreed) {
+      if (!userEmail.trim()) nextErrors.email = feedbackText.errors.emailRequired;
+      else if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(userEmail)) nextErrors.email = feedbackText.errors.emailInvalid;
+    }
+    setErrors(nextErrors);
+    return Object.keys(nextErrors).length === 0;
+  };
+
+  const submitFeedback = async () => {
+    if (!validateFeedback()) return;
+    setIsSubmitting(true);
+    setSubmitStatus('idle');
+    setSubmitErrorMessage('Failed to submit feedback. Please try again later.');
+    try {
+      const response = await fetch('/api/feedback', {
+        method: 'POST',
+        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+        body: JSON.stringify({
+          type: feedbackType === 'suggestion' ? 'Suggestion' : 'Bug',
+          reason: feedbackReason,
+          images: feedbackImages,
+          contactAgreed,
+          email: userEmail,
+        }),
+      });
+      if (!response.ok) {
+        const errorData = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
+        throw new Error(errorData.error || 'Submission failed');
+      }
+      setSubmitStatus('success');
+      setTimeout(() => {
+        onClose();
+        setFeedbackType(null);
+        setFeedbackReason('');
+        setFeedbackImages([]);
+        setContactAgreed(false);
+        setUserEmail('');
+        setSubmitStatus('idle');
+      }, 2000);
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.error('Feedback error:', error);
+      setSubmitErrorMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to submit feedback. Please try again later.');
+      setSubmitStatus('error');
+    } finally {
+      setIsSubmitting(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  if (!isOpen) return null;
+
+  return null;
+};

+      },
+      feedback: {
+        sectionTitle: '反馈',
+        successTitle: '反馈已提交',
+        successMessage: '感谢你的支持与反馈！',
+        typeLabel: '反馈类型',

+        detailPlaceholder: '请尽量详细描述你的建议，或你遇到的问题。',
+        screenshotsLabel: '截图（可选，最多 3 张）',
+        upload: '上传',
+        contactAgreement: '是否同意我们通过邮箱就这条反馈继续联系你？',
+        emailLabel: '邮箱地址',
+        emailPlaceholder: '请输入你的邮箱地址',
+        cancel: '取消',
+        submit: '提交',
+        submitting: '提交中...',
+        errors: {
+          uploadLimit: '最多只能上传 3 张图片。',
+          unsupportedImageType: '仅支持 JPG、PNG 和 GIF 格式。',
+          imageTooLarge: '每张图片必须小于 5MB。',
+          typeRequired: '请选择反馈类型。',
+          reasonRequired: '请填写你的建议，或描述你遇到的问题。',
+          emailRequired: '请输入邮箱地址。',
+          emailInvalid: '请输入有效的邮箱地址。',
+        },
+        screenshotAlt: (index) => `截图 ${index}`,
+      },
+    },
+    appHeader: {
+      toggleLibrary: '切换资料库',
+      uploadPdf: '上传 PDF',
+      changePdf: '更换 PDF',
+      feedback: '反馈',
+      settings: '设置',
+    },
+    uploadFlow: {
+      dropTitle: '拖拽 PDF 以上传',
+      dropDescription: '松开鼠标以上传演示文稿',
+      confirmTitle: '确认上传',
+      confirmDescription: (fileName) =>
+        `是否上传 “${fileName}”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。`,
+      cancel: '取消',
+      uploadNow: '立即上传',
+      invalidFileAlert: '请上传 PDF 文件。',
+      uploadFailedAlert: '上传 PDF 失败。请检查浏览器存储空间是否已满。',
+    },
+  },
+};
+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';

+import { useUiStore } from './store/uiStore';
+

+
+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({
+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Header/AppHeader', () => ({

+
+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),

+
+    usePdfStore.setState({
+      fileUrl: null,
+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,
+      pageNumber: 1,

+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);

+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {

+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

-  const handleImageUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {

-    let hasError = false;
-
-    Array.from(files).forEach(file => {
-      if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif'].includes(file.type)) {
-        newErrors.images = 'Only JPG, PNG, and GIF formats are supported';
-        hasError = true;
-        return;
-      }
-      if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
-        newErrors.images = 'Each image must be smaller than 5MB';
-        hasError = true;
-        return;
-      }
-
-      const reader = new FileReader();
-      reader.onload = (e) => {
-        if (e.target?.result) {
-          setFeedbackImages(prev => [...prev, e.target!.result as string]);
-        }
-      };
-      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
-    });
-
-    if (hasError) {
-      setErrors(newErrors);
-    }
-  };

-        newErrors.email = 'Please enter a valid email address';
-      }
-    }
-    setErrors(newErrors);
-    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
-  };

+import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
+import { AlertCircle, CheckCircle2, Cpu, Info, Loader2, MessageSquare, Palette, Upload, X } from 'lucide-react';
+
+import { MODEL_CONFIG, type OpenAiCompatibleEndpointPreset, type ProviderId, type SelectedModel, getOpenAiCompatibleBaseURL } from '../config/models';
+import { checkModelCapability } from '../lib/api/apiClient';
+import { APPLICATION_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS, OUTPUT_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS, getUIText } from '../lib/i18n';
+import { useUiStore } from '../store/uiStore';
+import { BuyCreditsDialog } from './settings/BuyCreditsDialog';
+import { PlatformApiSection } from './settings/PlatformApiSection';
+import { ThemeToggle } from './ThemeToggle';
+import { InfoTrigger } from './ui/InfoTrigger';
+
+interface SettingsModalProps {
+  isOpen: boolean;
+  onClose: () => void;
+  selectedModel: SelectedModel;
+  setSelectedModel: (model: SelectedModel) => void;
+  outputLanguage: string;
+  setOutputLanguage: (lang: string) => void;
+  isBuyCreditsDialogOpen?: boolean;
+  onOpenBuyCredits?: () => void;
+  onCloseBuyCredits?: () => void;
+}
+
+export const SettingsModal: React.FC<SettingsModalProps> = ({
+  isOpen,
+  onClose,
+  selectedModel,
+  setSelectedModel,
+  outputLanguage,
+  setOutputLanguage,
+  isBuyCreditsDialogOpen,
+  onOpenBuyCredits,
+  onCloseBuyCredits,
+}) => {
+  const activeTab = useUiStore((state) => state.settingsTab);
+  const setActiveTab = useUiStore((state) => state.setSettingsTab);
+  const aiAccess = useUiStore((state) => state.aiAccess);
+  const accessMode = useUiStore((state) => state.accessMode);
+  const applicationLanguage = useUiStore((state) => state.applicationLanguage);
+  const setApplicationLanguage = useUiStore((state) => state.setApplicationLanguage);
+  const modelCapabilityCheck = useUiStore((state) => state.modelCapabilityCheck);
+  const setAiAccess = useUiStore((state) => state.setAiAccess);
+  const setModelCapabilityCheck = useUiStore((state) => state.setModelCapabilityCheck);
+
+  const [feedbackType, setFeedbackType] = useState<'suggestion' | 'bug' | null>(null);
+  const [feedbackReason, setFeedbackReason] = useState('');
+  const [feedbackImages, setFeedbackImages] = useState<string[]>([]);
+  const [contactAgreed, setContactAgreed] = useState(false);
+  const [userEmail, setUserEmail] = useState('');
+  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
+  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
+  const [submitStatus, setSubmitStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'success' | 'error'>('idle');
+  const [submitErrorMessage, setSubmitErrorMessage] = useState('Failed to submit feedback. Please try again later.');
+  const [localBuyCreditsDialogOpen, setLocalBuyCreditsDialogOpen] = useState(false);
+
+  const buyCreditsDialogOpen = isBuyCreditsDialogOpen ?? localBuyCreditsDialogOpen;
+  const openBuyCreditsDialog = onOpenBuyCredits ?? (() => setLocalBuyCreditsDialogOpen(true));
+  const closeBuyCreditsDialog = onCloseBuyCredits ?? (() => setLocalBuyCreditsDialogOpen(false));
+
+  const text = getUIText(applicationLanguage).settingsModal;
+  const aiText = text.ai;
+  const appearanceText = text.appearance;
+  const aboutText = text.about;
+  const feedbackText = text.feedback;
+
+  const selectedEndpointPreset =
+    selectedModel.providerId === 'openai-compatible' ? selectedModel.endpointPreset || 'qwen' : undefined;
+
+  const selectedModelValue =
+    selectedModel.providerId === 'openai-compatible'
+      ? `openai-compatible|${selectedEndpointPreset}|${selectedModel.modelId}`
+      : `gemini|default|${selectedModel.modelId}`;
+
+  const updateOpenAiAccess = (updater: (current: typeof aiAccess.openAiCompatible) => typeof aiAccess.openAiCompatible) => {
+    setAiAccess({ ...aiAccess, openAiCompatible: updater(aiAccess.openAiCompatible) });
+  };
+
+  const updateParserAccess = (updater: (current: typeof aiAccess.parser) => typeof aiAccess.parser) => {
+    setAiAccess({ ...aiAccess, parser: updater(aiAccess.parser) });
+  };
+
+  const handleModelSelectionChange = (rawValue: string) => {
+    const [providerId, endpointPresetValue, modelId] = rawValue.split('|');
+    if (providerId === 'openai-compatible') {
+      const endpointPreset = endpointPresetValue as OpenAiCompatibleEndpointPreset;
+      setSelectedModel({ providerId: 'openai-compatible', endpointPreset, modelId });
+      updateOpenAiAccess((current) => ({
+        ...current,
+        endpointPreset,
+        baseURL: endpointPreset === 'custom' ? current.baseURL : getOpenAiCompatibleBaseURL(endpointPreset),
+      }));
+      return;
+    }
+    setSelectedModel({ providerId: providerId as ProviderId, modelId });
+  };
+
+  const byokConfigReady =
+    accessMode === 'byok' &&
+    (selectedModel.providerId === 'gemini'
+      ? aiAccess.gemini.apiKey.trim().length > 0
+      : aiAccess.openAiCompatible.apiKey.trim().length > 0 && aiAccess.openAiCompatible.baseURL.trim().length > 0);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (!isOpen || accessMode !== 'byok' || !byokConfigReady) return;
+    let cancelled = false;
+    const selection = {
+      providerId: selectedModel.providerId,
+      modelId: selectedModel.modelId,
+      endpointPreset: selectedModel.providerId === 'openai-compatible' ? selectedEndpointPreset : undefined,
+    };
+    setModelCapabilityCheck({ ...modelCapabilityCheck, status: 'checking', selection });
+    const timeoutId = window.setTimeout(() => {
+      checkModelCapability(selection)
+        .then((result) => {
+          if (!cancelled) setModelCapabilityCheck({ ...result, selection });
+        })
+        .catch(() => {
+          if (!cancelled) {
+            setModelCapabilityCheck({
+              status: 'pending',
+              checkedAt: null,
+              lastErrorCode: 'MODEL_CAPABILITY_CHECK_FAILED',
+              capabilitySummary: null,
+              selection,
+            });
+          }
+        });
+    }, 150);
+    return () => {
+      cancelled = true;
+      window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
+    };
+  }, [
+    accessMode,
+    aiAccess.gemini.apiKey,
+    aiAccess.openAiCompatible.apiKey,
+    aiAccess.openAiCompatible.baseURL,
+    byokConfigReady,
+    isOpen,
+    modelCapabilityCheck,
+    selectedEndpointPreset,
+    selectedModel.modelId,
+    selectedModel.providerId,
+    setModelCapabilityCheck,
+  ]);
+
+  const handleImageUpload = (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
+    const files = event.target.files;
+    if (!files) return;
+    const nextErrors = { ...errors };
+    delete nextErrors.images;
+    if (feedbackImages.length + files.length > 3) {
+      nextErrors.images = feedbackText.errors.uploadLimit;
+      setErrors(nextErrors);
+      return;
+    }
+    let hasError = false;
+    Array.from(files).forEach((file) => {
+      if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif'].includes(file.type)) {
+        nextErrors.images = feedbackText.errors.unsupportedImageType;
+        hasError = true;
+        return;
+      }
+      if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
+        nextErrors.images = feedbackText.errors.imageTooLarge;
+        hasError = true;
+        return;
+      }
+      const reader = new FileReader();
+      reader.onload = (readerEvent) => {
+        if (readerEvent.target?.result) {
+          setFeedbackImages((prev) => [...prev, readerEvent.target!.result as string]);
+        }
+      };
+      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
+    });
+    if (hasError) setErrors(nextErrors);
+  };
+
+  const removeImage = (index: number) => {
+    setFeedbackImages((prev) => prev.filter((_, imageIndex) => imageIndex !== index));
+  };
+
+  const validateFeedback = () => {
+    const nextErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
+    if (!feedbackType) nextErrors.type = feedbackText.errors.typeRequired;
+    if (!feedbackReason.trim()) nextErrors.reason = feedbackText.errors.reasonRequired;
+    if (contactAgreed) {
+      if (!userEmail.trim()) nextErrors.email = feedbackText.errors.emailRequired;
+      else if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(userEmail)) nextErrors.email = feedbackText.errors.emailInvalid;
+    }
+    setErrors(nextErrors);
+    return Object.keys(nextErrors).length === 0;
+  };
+
+  const submitFeedback = async () => {
+    if (!validateFeedback()) return;
+    setIsSubmitting(true);
+    setSubmitStatus('idle');
+    setSubmitErrorMessage('Failed to submit feedback. Please try again later.');
+    try {
+      const response = await fetch('/api/feedback', {
+        method: 'POST',
+        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+        body: JSON.stringify({
+          type: feedbackType === 'suggestion' ? 'Suggestion' : 'Bug',
+          reason: feedbackReason,
+          images: feedbackImages,
+          contactAgreed,
+          email: userEmail,
+        }),
+      });
+      if (!response.ok) {
+        const errorData = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
+        throw new Error(errorData.error || 'Submission failed');
+      }
+      setSubmitStatus('success');
+      setTimeout(() => {
+        onClose();
+        setFeedbackType(null);
+        setFeedbackReason('');
+        setFeedbackImages([]);
+        setContactAgreed(false);
+        setUserEmail('');
+        setSubmitStatus('idle');
+      }, 2000);
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.error('Feedback error:', error);
+      setSubmitErrorMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to submit feedback. Please try again later.');
+      setSubmitStatus('error');
+    } finally {
+      setIsSubmitting(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  if (!isOpen) return null;
+
+  const renderAiContent = () => null;
+  const renderAppearanceContent = () => null;
+  const renderAboutContent = () => null;
+  const renderFeedbackContent = () => null;
+
+  return (
+    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4">
+      <div className="bg-bg-elevated rounded-xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden border border-border-subtle">
+        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 border-b border-border-subtle shrink-0">
+          <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-text-primary">{text.modalTitle}</h2>
+          <button
+            onClick={onClose}
+            className="text-text-muted hover:text-text-secondary p-1 rounded-md hover:bg-bg-surface transition-colors"
+          >
+            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
+          </button>
+        </div>
+
+        <div className="flex flex-1 overflow-hidden">
+          <div className="w-56 bg-bg-surface border-r border-border-subtle p-4 space-y-2 shrink-0 overflow-y-auto">
+            <button
+              onClick={() => setActiveTab('ai')}
+              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${
+                activeTab === 'ai' ? 'bg-bg-base text-text-primary' : 'text-text-secondary hover:bg-bg-base'
+              }`}
+            >
+              <Cpu className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
+              {text.tabs.ai}
+            </button>
+            <button
+              onClick={() => setActiveTab('appearance')}
+              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${
+                activeTab === 'appearance'
+                  ? 'bg-bg-base text-text-primary'
+                  : 'text-text-secondary hover:bg-bg-base'
+              }`}
+            >
+              <Palette className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
+              {text.tabs.appearance}
+            </button>
+            <button
+              onClick={() => setActiveTab('about')}
+              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${
+                activeTab === 'about' ? 'bg-bg-base text-text-primary' : 'text-text-secondary hover:bg-bg-base'
+              }`}
+            >
+              <Info className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
+              {text.tabs.about}
+            </button>
+            <button
+              onClick={() => setActiveTab('feedback')}
+              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${
+                activeTab === 'feedback'
+                  ? 'bg-bg-base text-text-primary'
+                  : 'text-text-secondary hover:bg-bg-base'
+              }`}
+            >
+              <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
+              {text.tabs.feedback}
+            </button>
+          </div>
+
+          <div className="flex-1 p-6 overflow-y-auto">
+            {activeTab === 'ai' && renderAiContent()}
+            {activeTab === 'appearance' && renderAppearanceContent()}
+            {activeTab === 'about' && renderAboutContent()}
+            {activeTab === 'feedback' && renderFeedbackContent()}
+          </div>
+        </div>
+      </div>
+      <BuyCreditsDialog isOpen={buyCreditsDialogOpen} onClose={closeBuyCreditsDialog} />
+    </div>
+  );
+};

+        errors: {
+          uploadLimit: '最多只能上传 3 张图片。',
+          unsupportedImageType: '仅支持 JPG、PNG 和 GIF 格式。',
+          imageTooLarge: '每张图片必须小于 5MB。',
+          typeRequired: '请选择反馈类型。',
+          reasonRequired: '请填写你的建议，或描述你遇到的问题。',
+          emailRequired: '请输入邮箱地址。',
+          emailInvalid: '请输入有效的邮箱地址。',
+        },
+        screenshotAlt: (index) => `截图 ${index}`,
+      },
+    },
+    appHeader: {
+      toggleLibrary: '切换资料库',
+      uploadPdf: '上传 PDF',
+      changePdf: '更换 PDF',
+      feedback: '反馈',
+      settings: '设置',
+    },
+    uploadFlow: {
+      dropTitle: '拖拽 PDF 以上传',
+      dropDescription: '松开鼠标以上传演示文稿',
+      confirmTitle: '确认上传',
+      confirmDescription: (fileName) =>
+        `是否上传 “${fileName}”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。`,
+      cancel: '取消',
+      uploadNow: '立即上传',
+      invalidFileAlert: '请上传 PDF 文件。',
+      uploadFailedAlert: '上传 PDF 失败。请检查浏览器存储空间是否已满。',
+    },
+  },
+};
+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import App from './App';
+import { usePdfStore } from './store/pdfStore';
+import { useTutorStore } from './store/tutorStore';
+import { useUiStore } from './store/uiStore';
+
+const savePDFMock = vi.fn();
+const migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock = vi.fn();
+
+vi.mock('./lib/db', () => ({
+  savePDF: savePDFMock,
+  updatePDFState: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFTags: vi.fn(),
+  updatePDFLastPage: vi.fn(),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./lib/migrate', () => ({
+  migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDB: migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock,
+}));
+
+vi.mock('uuid', () => ({
+  v4: () => 'pdf-test-id',
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/PdfViewer', () => ({
+  PdfViewer: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="pdf-viewer" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CanvasTutor', () => ({
+  CanvasTutor: vi.fn(({ children }) => <div data-testid="canvas-tutor">{children}</div>),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/AskYouTutor', () => ({
+  AskYouTutor: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="ask-you-tutor" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Sidebar/LibrarySidebar', () => ({
+  LibrarySidebar: vi.fn(() => <div data-testid="library-sidebar" />),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/CreditsRequiredDialog', () => ({
+  CreditsRequiredDialog: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/SettingsModal', () => ({
+  SettingsModal: vi.fn(() => null),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./components/Header/AppHeader', () => ({
+  AppHeader: vi.fn(({ onFileUpload }) => (
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      onClick={() =>
+        onFileUpload({
+          target: {
+            files: [new File(['%PDF-1.4'], 'chapter-1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })],
+            value: '',
+          },
+        } as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>)
+      }
+    >
+      Trigger Upload
+    </button>
+  )),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useSlideAnalysis', () => ({
+  useSlideAnalysis: vi.fn(() => ({
+    explainSlide: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useFollowUp', () => ({
+  useFollowUp: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleSendMessage: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+    handleRegenerateFollowUp: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useNotes', () => ({
+  useNotes: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleAddNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeleteNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleEditNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleConvertSpatialNote: vi.fn(),
+    handleMoveNote: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useQuiz', () => ({
+  useQuiz: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleGenerateQuestions: vi.fn(),
+    handleAnswersChange: vi.fn(),
+    handleSubmitAnswers: vi.fn(),
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/useChunkRegenerate', () => ({
+  useChunkRegenerate: vi.fn(() => ({
+    handleRegenerateChunk: vi.fn(),
+    regeneratingChunks: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('./hooks/usePdfLibrary', () => ({
+  usePdfLibrary: vi.fn(() => ({
+    loadPdfFromDb: vi.fn(),
+    handleDeletePdf: vi.fn(),
+    loadSavedPdfs: vi.fn(),
+    savedPdfs: [],
+  })),
+}));
+
+describe('App upload path i18n', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    migrateLocalStorageToIndexedDBMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    savePDFMock.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockReturnValue('blob:pdf-test');
+    vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'alert').mockImplementation(() => {});
+
+    useUiStore.setState({
+      applicationLanguage: 'zh-CN',
+      outputLanguage: 'English',
+      isSettingsOpen: false,
+      settingsTab: 'ai',
+      accessMode: 'byok',
+      insufficientCreditsDialog: null,
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+
+    usePdfStore.setState({
+      fileUrl: null,
+      fileName: null,
+      currentPdfId: null,
+      numPages: 0,
+      pageNumber: 1,
+      leftWidth: 50,
+    } as any);
+
+    useTutorStore.setState({
+      pagesState: {},
+      mode: 'learn',
+      isGeneratingAskYou: false,
+      isSubmittingAskYou: false,
+      isAutoAnalyzing: false,
+      globalAnalysisStatus: 'idle',
+      globalProgress: { current: 0, total: 0, failedPages: [] },
+      init: vi.fn(async () => {}),
+    } as any);
+  });
+
+  it('shows localized drag-and-drop and confirm-upload copy in the main upload flow', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.dragEnter(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('拖拽 PDF 以上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('松开鼠标以上传演示文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Trigger Upload' }));
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('确认上传')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('是否上传 “chapter-1.pdf”？这会替换你当前的演示文稿。')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '取消' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '立即上传' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('shows a localized alert when a non-pdf file is dropped', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<App />);
+    const appRoot = container.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+
+    fireEvent.drop(appRoot, {
+      dataTransfer: {
+        files: [new File(['plain text'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })],
+        types: ['Files'],
+      },
+    });
+
+    expect(window.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('请上传 PDF 文件。');
+  });
+});

-  const handleImageUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {

-    const newErrors = { ...errors };

-    Array.from(files).forEach(file => {
-      if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif'].includes(file.type)) {

-        hasError = true;
-        return;
-      }
-      if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {

-        hasError = true;
-        return;
-      }
-
-      const reader = new FileReader();
-      reader.onload = (e) => {
-        if (e.target?.result) {
-          setFeedbackImages(prev => [...prev, e.target!.result as string]);
-        }
-      };
-      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
-    });
-
-    if (hasError) {
-      setErrors(newErrors);
-    }
-  };

-    setErrors(newErrors);
-    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;

+import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
+import { AlertCircle, CheckCircle2, Cpu, Info, Loader2, MessageSquare, Palette, Upload, X } from 'lucide-react';
+
+import { MODEL_CONFIG, type OpenAiCompatibleEndpointPreset, type ProviderId, type SelectedModel, getOpenAiCompatibleBaseURL } from '../config/models';
+import { checkModelCapability } from '../lib/api/apiClient';
+import { APPLICATION_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS, OUTPUT_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS, getUIText } from '../lib/i18n';
+import { useUiStore } from '../store/uiStore';
+import { BuyCreditsDialog } from './settings/BuyCreditsDialog';
+import { PlatformApiSection } from './settings/PlatformApiSection';
+import { ThemeToggle } from './ThemeToggle';
+import { InfoTrigger } from './ui/InfoTrigger';
+
+interface SettingsModalProps {
+  isOpen: boolean;
+  onClose: () => void;
+  selectedModel: SelectedModel;
+  setSelectedModel: (model: SelectedModel) => void;
+  outputLanguage: string;
+  setOutputLanguage: (lang: string) => void;
+  isBuyCreditsDialogOpen?: boolean;
+  onOpenBuyCredits?: () => void;
+  onCloseBuyCredits?: () => void;
+}
+
+export const SettingsModal: React.FC<SettingsModalProps> = ({
+  isOpen,
+  onClose,
+  selectedModel,
+  setSelectedModel,
+  outputLanguage,
+  setOutputLanguage,
+  isBuyCreditsDialogOpen,
+  onOpenBuyCredits,
+  onCloseBuyCredits,
+}) => {
+  const activeTab = useUiStore((state) => state.settingsTab);
+  const setActiveTab = useUiStore((state) => state.setSettingsTab);
+  const aiAccess = useUiStore((state) => state.aiAccess);
+  const accessMode = useUiStore((state) => state.accessMode);
+  const applicationLanguage = useUiStore((state) => state.applicationLanguage);
+  const setApplicationLanguage = useUiStore((state) => state.setApplicationLanguage);
+  const modelCapabilityCheck = useUiStore((state) => state.modelCapabilityCheck);
+  const setAiAccess = useUiStore((state) => state.setAiAccess);
+  const setModelCapabilityCheck = useUiStore((state) => state.setModelCapabilityCheck);
+
+  const [feedbackType, setFeedbackType] = useState<'suggestion' | 'bug' | null>(null);
+  const [feedbackReason, setFeedbackReason] = useState('');
+  const [feedbackImages, setFeedbackImages] = useState<string[]>([]);
+  const [contactAgreed, setContactAgreed] = useState(false);
+  const [userEmail, setUserEmail] = useState('');
+  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
+  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
+  const [submitStatus, setSubmitStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'success' | 'error'>('idle');
+  const [submitErrorMessage, setSubmitErrorMessage] = useState('Failed to submit feedback. Please try again later.');
+  const [localBuyCreditsDialogOpen, setLocalBuyCreditsDialogOpen] = useState(false);
+
+  const buyCreditsDialogOpen = isBuyCreditsDialogOpen ?? localBuyCreditsDialogOpen;
+  const openBuyCreditsDialog = onOpenBuyCredits ?? (() => setLocalBuyCreditsDialogOpen(true));
+  const closeBuyCreditsDialog = onCloseBuyCredits ?? (() => setLocalBuyCreditsDialogOpen(false));
+
+  const text = getUIText(applicationLanguage).settingsModal;
+  const aiText = text.ai;
+  const appearanceText = text.appearance;
+  const aboutText = text.about;
+  const feedbackText = text.feedback;
+
+  const selectedEndpointPreset =
+    selectedModel.providerId === 'openai-compatible' ? selectedModel.endpointPreset || 'qwen' : undefined;
+
+  const selectedModelValue =
+    selectedModel.providerId === 'openai-compatible'
+      ? `openai-compatible|${selectedEndpointPreset}|${selectedModel.modelId}`
+      : `gemini|default|${selectedModel.modelId}`;
+
+  const updateOpenAiAccess = (updater: (current: typeof aiAccess.openAiCompatible) => typeof aiAccess.openAiCompatible) => {
+    setAiAccess({ ...aiAccess, openAiCompatible: updater(aiAccess.openAiCompatible) });
+  };
+
+  const updateParserAccess = (updater: (current: typeof aiAccess.parser) => typeof aiAccess.parser) => {
+    setAiAccess({ ...aiAccess, parser: updater(aiAccess.parser) });
+  };
+
+  const handleModelSelectionChange = (rawValue: string) => {
+    const [providerId, endpointPresetValue, modelId] = rawValue.split('|');
+    if (providerId === 'openai-compatible') {
+      const endpointPreset = endpointPresetValue as OpenAiCompatibleEndpointPreset;
+      setSelectedModel({ providerId: 'openai-compatible', endpointPreset, modelId });
+      updateOpenAiAccess((current) => ({
+        ...current,
+        endpointPreset,
+        baseURL: endpointPreset === 'custom' ? current.baseURL : getOpenAiCompatibleBaseURL(endpointPreset),
+      }));
+      return;
+    }
+    setSelectedModel({ providerId: providerId as ProviderId, modelId });
+  };
+
+  const byokConfigReady =
+    accessMode === 'byok' &&
+    (selectedModel.providerId === 'gemini'
+      ? aiAccess.gemini.apiKey.trim().length > 0
+      : aiAccess.openAiCompatible.apiKey.trim().length > 0 && aiAccess.openAiCompatible.baseURL.trim().length > 0);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (!isOpen || accessMode !== 'byok' || !byokConfigReady) return;
+    let cancelled = false;
+    const selection = {
+      providerId: selectedModel.providerId,
+      modelId: selectedModel.modelId,
+      endpointPreset: selectedModel.providerId === 'openai-compatible' ? selectedEndpointPreset : undefined,
+    };
+    setModelCapabilityCheck({ ...modelCapabilityCheck, status: 'checking', selection });
+    const timeoutId = window.setTimeout(() => {
+      checkModelCapability(selection)
+        .then((result) => {
+          if (!cancelled) setModelCapabilityCheck({ ...result, selection });
+        })
+        .catch(() => {
+          if (!cancelled) {
+            setModelCapabilityCheck({
+              status: 'pending',
+              checkedAt: null,
+              lastErrorCode: 'MODEL_CAPABILITY_CHECK_FAILED',
+              capabilitySummary: null,
+              selection,
+            });
+          }
+        });
+    }, 150);
+    return () => {
+      cancelled = true;
+      window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
+    };
+  }, [
+    accessMode,
+    aiAccess.gemini.apiKey,
+    aiAccess.openAiCompatible.apiKey,
+    aiAccess.openAiCompatible.baseURL,
+    byokConfigReady,
+    isOpen,
+    modelCapabilityCheck,
+    selectedEndpointPreset,
+    selectedModel.modelId,
+    selectedModel.providerId,
+    setModelCapabilityCheck,
+  ]);
+
+  const handleImageUpload = (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
+    const files = event.target.files;
+    if (!files) return;
+    const nextErrors = { ...errors };
+    delete nextErrors.images;
+    if (feedbackImages.length + files.length > 3) {
+      nextErrors.images = feedbackText.errors.uploadLimit;
+      setErrors(nextErrors);
+      return;
+    }
+    let hasError = false;
+    Array.from(files).forEach((file) => {
+      if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif'].includes(file.type)) {
+        nextErrors.images = feedbackText.errors.unsupportedImageType;
+        hasError = true;
+        return;
+      }
+      if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
+        nextErrors.images = feedbackText.errors.imageTooLarge;
+        hasError = true;
+        return;
+      }
+      const reader = new FileReader();
+      reader.onload = (readerEvent) => {
+        if (readerEvent.target?.result) {
+          setFeedbackImages((prev) => [...prev, readerEvent.target!.result as string]);
+        }
+      };
+      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
+    });
+    if (hasError) setErrors(nextErrors);
+  };
+
+  const removeImage = (index: number) => {
+    setFeedbackImages((prev) => prev.filter((_, imageIndex) => imageIndex !== index));
+  };
+
+  const validateFeedback = () => {
+    const nextErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
+    if (!feedbackType) nextErrors.type = feedbackText.errors.typeRequired;
+    if (!feedbackReason.trim()) nextErrors.reason = feedbackText.errors.reasonRequired;
+    if (contactAgreed) {
+      if (!userEmail.trim()) nextErrors.email = feedbackText.errors.emailRequired;
+      else if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(userEmail)) nextErrors.email = feedbackText.errors.emailInvalid;
+    }
+    setErrors(nextErrors);
+    return Object.keys(nextErrors).length === 0;
+  };
+
+  const submitFeedback = async () => {
+    if (!validateFeedback()) return;
+    setIsSubmitting(true);
+    setSubmitStatus('idle');
+    setSubmitErrorMessage('Failed to submit feedback. Please try again later.');
+    try {
+      const response = await fetch('/api/feedback', {
+        method: 'POST',
+        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+        body: JSON.stringify({
+          type: feedbackType === 'suggestion' ? 'Suggestion' : 'Bug',
+          reason: feedbackReason,
+          images: feedbackImages,
+          contactAgreed,
+          email: userEmail,
+        }),
+      });
+      if (!response.ok) {
+        const errorData = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
+        throw new Error(errorData.error || 'Submission failed');
+      }
+      setSubmitStatus('success');
+      setTimeout(() => {
+        onClose();
+        setFeedbackType(null);
+        setFeedbackReason('');
+        setFeedbackImages([]);
+        setContactAgreed(false);
+        setUserEmail('');
+        setSubmitStatus('idle');
+      }, 2000);
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.error('Feedback error:', error);
+      setSubmitErrorMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to submit feedback. Please try again later.');
+      setSubmitStatus('error');
+    } finally {
+      setIsSubmitting(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  if (!isOpen) return null;
+
+  const renderAiContent = () => null;
+  const renderAppearanceContent = () => null;
+  const renderAboutContent = () => null;
+  const renderFeedbackContent = () => null;
+
+  return (
+    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4">
+      <div className="bg-bg-elevated rounded-xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden border border-border-subtle">
+        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 border-b border-border-subtle shrink-0">
+          <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-text-primary">{text.modalTitle}</h2>
+          <button
+            onClick={onClose}
+            className="text-text-muted hover:text-text-secondary p-1 rounded-md hover:bg-bg-surface transition-colors"
+          >
+            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
+          </button>
+        </div>
+
+        <div className="flex flex-1 overflow-hidden">
+          <div className="w-56 bg-bg-surface border-r border-border-subtle p-4 space-y-2 shrink-0 overflow-y-auto">
+            <button
+              onClick={() => setActiveTab('ai')}
+              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${
+                activeTab === 'ai' ? 'bg-bg-base text-text-primary' : 'text-text-secondary hover:bg-bg-base'
+              }`}
+            >
+              <Cpu className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
+              {text.tabs.ai}
+            </button>
+            <button
+              onClick={() => setActiveTab('appearance')}
+              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${
+                activeTab === 'appearance'
+                  ? 'bg-bg-base text-text-primary'
+                  : 'text-text-secondary hover:bg-bg-base'
+              }`}
+            >
+              <Palette className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
+              {text.tabs.appearance}
+            </button>
+            <button
+              onClick={() => setActiveTab('about')}
+              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${
+                activeTab === 'about' ? 'bg-bg-base text-text-primary' : 'text-text-secondary hover:bg-bg-base'
+              }`}
+            >
+              <Info className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
+              {text.tabs.about}
+            </button>
+            <button
+              onClick={() => setActiveTab('feedback')}
+              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${
+                activeTab === 'feedback'
+                  ? 'bg-bg-base text-text-primary'
+                  : 'text-text-secondary hover:bg-bg-base'
+              }`}
+            >
+              <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
+              {text.tabs.feedback}
+            </button>
+          </div>
+
+          <div className="flex-1 p-6 overflow-y-auto">
+            {activeTab === 'ai' && renderAiContent()}
+            {activeTab === 'appearance' && renderAppearanceContent()}
+            {activeTab === 'about' && renderAboutContent()}
+            {activeTab === 'feedback' && renderFeedbackContent()}
+          </div>
+        </div>
+      </div>
+      <BuyCreditsDialog isOpen={buyCreditsDialogOpen} onClose={closeBuyCreditsDialog} />
+    </div>
+  );
+};

+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}

-  const handleImageUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {

-    const newErrors = { ...errors };

-    const newImages: string[] = [];

-
-    Array.from(files).forEach(file => {
-      if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif'].includes(file.type)) {
-        newErrors.images = 'Only JPG, PNG, and GIF formats are supported';

-        return;

-        return;

-
-      const reader = new FileReader();

-        if (e.target?.result) {
-          setFeedbackImages(prev => [...prev, e.target!.result as string]);
-        }
-      };
-      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
-    });
-
-    if (hasError) {
-      setErrors(newErrors);
-    }
-  };

+
+  const buyCreditsDialogOpen = isBuyCreditsDialogOpen ?? localBuyCreditsDialogOpen;
+  const openBuyCreditsDialog = onOpenBuyCredits ?? (() => setLocalBuyCreditsDialogOpen(true));

+  const text = getUIText(applicationLanguage).settingsModal;

+  const selectedEndpointPreset =

+  const handleImageUpload = (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {

+              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${
+                activeTab === 'ai' ? 'bg-bg-base text-text-primary' : 'text-text-secondary hover:bg-bg-base'
+              }`}
+            >
+              <Cpu className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
+              {text.tabs.ai}
+            </button>
+            <button
+              onClick={() => setActiveTab('appearance')}
+              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${
+                activeTab === 'appearance'
+                  ? 'bg-bg-base text-text-primary'
+                  : 'text-text-secondary hover:bg-bg-base'
+              }`}
+            >
+              <Palette className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
+              {text.tabs.appearance}
+            </button>
+            <button
+              onClick={() => setActiveTab('about')}
+              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${
+                activeTab === 'about' ? 'bg-bg-base text-text-primary' : 'text-text-secondary hover:bg-bg-base'
+              }`}
+            >
+              <Info className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
+              {text.tabs.about}
+            </button>
+            <button
+              onClick={() => setActiveTab('feedback')}
+              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${
+                activeTab === 'feedback'
+                  ? 'bg-bg-base text-text-primary'
+                  : 'text-text-secondary hover:bg-bg-base'
+              }`}
+            >
+              <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
+              {text.tabs.feedback}
+            </button>
+          </div>
+
+          <div className="flex-1 p-6 overflow-y-auto">
+            {activeTab === 'ai' && renderAiContent()}
+            {activeTab === 'appearance' && renderAppearanceContent()}
+            {activeTab === 'about' && renderAboutContent()}
+            {activeTab === 'feedback' && renderFeedbackContent()}
+          </div>
+        </div>
+      </div>
+      <BuyCreditsDialog isOpen={buyCreditsDialogOpen} onClose={closeBuyCreditsDialog} />
+    </div>
+  );
+};

+          reasonRequired: '请填写你的建议，或描述你遇到的问题。',
+          emailRequired: '请输入邮箱地址。',
+          emailInvalid: '请输入有效的邮箱地址。',

+      changePdf: '更换 PDF',

+      settings: '设置',
+    },
+    uploadFlow: {

+      dropDescription: '松开鼠标以上传演示文稿',

+      invalidFileAlert: '请上传 PDF 文件。',

+    },

+
+export function getDefaultApplicationLanguage(locale?: string): ApplicationLanguage {
+  const candidate = (locale ?? globalThis.navigator?.language ?? 'en').toLowerCase();
+  return candidate.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
+}
+
+export function normalizeApplicationLanguage(
+  language: unknown,
+  fallback: ApplicationLanguage = getDefaultApplicationLanguage(),
+): ApplicationLanguage {
+  return SUPPORTED_APPLICATION_LANGUAGES.includes(language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    ? (language as ApplicationLanguage)
+    : fallback;
+}
+
+export function getUIText(language: unknown): UIText {
+  return uiText[normalizeApplicationLanguage(language, 'en')];
+}
